jobs.company: King's College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
jobs.title: Medical Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
The post holder will work as part of a diverse and multidisciplinary Medical Equipment Management Service team to ensure the safe use of medical devices across the Trust. The post holder will carry out acceptance testing, servicing and repair of complex medical equipment and devices. They will take part in workshop rotas and timetables and maintain records of all completed work timely and accurately on the comprehensive equipment management information technology system. Where necessary the post holder will undertake training to develop, upskill and fulfil the evolving needs of the role.
  
  

Technical
  
  

Following standard operating procedures, carry out the following on complex electrical and mechanical
  
  

**Medical equipment:**  

Formal acceptance tests
  
Performance tests
  
Planned Preventative Maintenance
  
Servicing / Routine maintenance
  
  

Under the supervision of senior technicians, analyse and diagnose faults in complex electrical and mechanical medical equipment and calibrate and operate test equipment correctly.
  
  

Carry out electrical safety testing of equipment.
  
  

The Trust provides a full range of local and specialist services across its five sites. In June 2026, we launched our new strategy for 2026\-31\. Our vision is to transform healthcare, and we have agreed six strategic ambitions to help us improve care for patients, and the working lives of our staff.
  
  

Our six strategic ambitions are delivering high\-quality patient care ; creating a great place to work ; leading pioneering research, innovation and education ; building strong and successful partnerships ; providing timely and efficient care ; and ensuring long\-term financial sustainability .
  
  

We have also agreed four new organisational values – Caring, Collaborative, Inclusive, Innovative – and these underpin everything we do, and how our teams interact with the patients under our care.
  
  

We are at a pivotal point in our history and we require individuals who are ready to join a highly professional team and make a real, lasting difference to our patients and our people.
  
  

King’s is committed to delivering Sustainable Healthcare for All via our Green Plan. In line with national Greener NHS ambitions, we have set net zero carbon targets of 2040 for our NHS Carbon Footprint and 2045 for our NHS Carbon Footprint Plus. Everyone’s contribution is required in order to meet the goals set out in our Green Plan and we encourage all staff to work responsibly, minimising their contributions to the Trust’s carbon emissions, waste and pollution wherever possible.
  
  

Communication
  
  

Provide technical information and feedback to clinical users on the service and repair of equipment.
  
Communicate with equipment suppliers and manufacturers regarding maintenance and repair of medical equipment.
  
Collaborate with other technical staff in the maintenance of medical equipment.
  
  

Clinical
  
  

Attend clinical areas to carry out routine maintenance of medical equipment, either alone or with colleagues
  
  

Quality Control
  
  

Adhere to the processes and procedures as described in the quality manual.
  
Comment on proposed changes to departmental policies and procedures.
  
  

Records
  
  

Accurately and clearly record work done on the medical equipment management database.
  
Check that information provided on equipment is correct, that procedures for adding and updating information is followed and any anomalies are reported to the team leader.
  
  

Time Management
  
  

Plans own workload and prioritises breakdown requests allocated to self.
  
Organises routine maintenance duties allocated to self.
  
  

Physical
  
  

Assist with the movement and transport of equipment and packages, of up to 20kgs, to and from clinical areas, and between MEMS sites.
  
Carry out repetitive equipment testing which may require working in awkward positions where testing carried out on\-site.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Title: QA Automation Engineer**

**Salary: £39,000 \- £46,000**

**Location: Bristol, Future Space, UWE**

**Contract: Permanent, 37\.5 Hours Per week**

**At Everything Financial, the success of our business depends on the quality of the products we create.**

As a Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you’ll be a vital first line of assurance, helping us make sure the things we build do what our stakeholders need them to do and that our products perform brilliantly every time.

You’ll combine hands\-on automation expertise with strong problem\-solving skills, taking ownership of testing across the delivery lifecycle and working closely with stakeholders and technical teams to continuously improve the quality of our products.

**A day in the life of a QA Automation Engineer will involve:**

* Developing and maintaining automated test suites for UI and API applications, helping ensure functionality, reliability and quality across releases.
* Planning, estimating, prioritising and coordinating testing activities, alongside creating comprehensive test strategies, test plans and well\-structured test cases.
* Developing and continuously improving our automation tools, frameworks and architecture, including CI/CD and DevOps, to make testing increasingly effective and efficient.
* Delivering functional testing across UI, APIs and databases, generating accurate test data that covers diverse scenarios, including edge cases and negative paths.
* Carrying out regression, cross\-browser and non\-functional testing, including load, performance, security, OAT and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Identifying, documenting and tracking bugs, keeping stakeholders informed of their impact, conducting root\-cause analysis and recommending workable solutions.
* Producing clear QA documentation, processes, requirements, specifications and technical design documents, while keeping test cases centrally maintained within Testmo.
* Working collaboratively with technical teams and stakeholders, providing technical guidance and contributing to post\-live assessments and continuous improvement.

**To be a successful QA Automation Engineer, you’ll need**

* Strong knowledge of software development, software testing and new product development principles and processes, with the ability to plan testing for complex systems.
* Strong knowledge of testing frameworks and techniques, including BDD, TDD and the Page Object Model.
* Strong knowledge of programming languages and formats such as C\#, JavaScript, TypeScript and JSON, alongside open\-source tools and platforms including Playwright, Git and Node.js.
* Solid understanding of backend testing, including REST or SOAP APIs, Postman and SQL database testing.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, cloud platforms and DevOps, together with non\-functional testing approaches and tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, penetration testing, security testing, OAT and UAT.
* Experience using tools to automate the testing of email and SMS journeys, including verifying delivery, content and timing within a test automation framework.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical and decision\-making skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and delivery commitments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to translate technical testing findings into practical improvements for business and consumer outcomes.

**In return for your skills and expertise, you'll get:**

* A salary between £39k and £46k, dependent on experience
* 30 days annual leave, plus bank holidays
* Access to our profit Related Pay bonus scheme
* An allowance towards the cost of your wifi for working from home, and gym membership.
* A pension through Nest

*At Everything Financial, we pride ourselves on our diverse workforce, and ensuring we have an inclusive environment for all our team members. We remain committed to ensuring our teams can bring their true selves to work without risk or fear of discrimination.*

Pay: £39,000\.00\-£46,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bristol BS34 8RB

jobs.title: Process Design & Development Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Process Design \& Development Engineer – MPD Process Development**

**Wotton under Edge**

**up to £40,000 depending on experience**

 **The purpose of the role**

  

Renishaw's Machine Tool Products Division (MPD) is looking for a Process Design \& Development Engineer to join the Process Software Team. This is a multidisciplinary engineering role focused on the development of automated assembly and test systems used throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept evaluation through to full production. Working within a focused and collaborative team, you will design, develop, validate and implement innovative test rigs, manufacturing processes and automation solutions, combining mechanical, electrical and software engineering disciplines to deliver robust and capable systems.

 **Responsibilities**

* Design and develop automated assembly and test systems for new and existing products.
* Work closely with product development teams from concept through to production to define process and test requirements.
* Design, prototype and validate test equipment, tooling, fixtures and manufacturing processes.
* Develop software solutions using technologies such as C\#, LabVIEW, PLC and SQL to control, monitor and analyse automated systems.
* Integrate sensors, instrumentation, motion control and data acquisition technologies into complex test environments.
* Analyse test and process data to validate performance, capability and measurement system effectiveness.
* Produce clear documentation including requirements specifications, design documentation, validation reports and handover information.
* Work with manufacturing, NPI, project teams and specialist engineering groups to ensure solutions are safe, robust, efficient and manufacturable.
* Investigate production and yield issues, identifying improvements to both products and processes.
* Support continuous improvement activities across assembly, test and manufacturing operations.
* Manage or support the sourcing, procurement and implementation of equipment and tooling required for new processes.

 **Key Requirements**

* Degree, HNC/HND or equivalent experience in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
* Experience with software development (e.g. C\#, LabVIEW, PLC) for the design or support of automated test systems, manufacturing equipment, and production processes.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyse data and apply engineering judgement to drive decisions and improvements.
* Experience working within a structured engineering environment, including design reviews, validation activities and documentation.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Desire to be hands on outside of the core day\-to\-day functions, debugging rig issues or satisfying customer orders where necessary (bespoke rig builds).

  



**Desirable Requirements**

* Understanding of precision assembly or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of statistical process control, Gauge R\&R, MSA, CpK and process capability analysis.
* Experience with CAD packages such as Siemens NX or equivalent.
* Understanding of electrical design, control systems or industrial communications.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar project management and software version control tools.
* Experience developing production test equipment or manufacturing automation solutions.
* Knowledge of DfM, DfA, Process FMEA or Six Sigma methodologies.

 **Person Specification**

  

The successful applicant will be a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges. They will be comfortable working across multiple engineering disciplines and keen to develop new skills outside their primary area of expertise.


They will demonstrate:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Clear communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality engineering solutions.
* Attention to detail and a methodical approach to engineering activities.
* A willingness to learn and collaborate with specialists from different disciplines.
* The ability to balance practical hands\-on work with engineering rigour and documentation.

 **Opportunities for Career Development and Training**

  

We are committed to supporting engineers in developing broad, multidisciplinary skill sets. The successful candidate will have opportunities to gain experience across software, electronics, mechanical design and systems engineering while contributing to real\-world automation and manufacturing challenges.

  

Training and development opportunities include:

* C\# and software development training.
* NI training and development programmes for LabVIEW.
* Siemens NX and mechanical design training.
* Mentoring and technical reviews from experienced software, electronics and mechanical engineers.
* Training in process validation, measurement systems analysis and manufacturing statistics.
* Exposure to full product lifecycle development, from concept through to production deployment.
* Internal professional development courses including presentation skills, report writing, project management and leadership.
* Opportunities to pursue additional technical or professional training aligned with business and personal development goals.

 **Benefits**

  

When you join Renishaw, we're committing to your future career. That's because we believe in developing our people's skills and promoting them internally. We also offer a benefits package that's highly desirable; including a 9% non\-contributory pension, discretionary annual bonus, \*subsidised onsite restaurants and \*coffee shops, free parking, \*car sharing scheme and \*24 hour fitness centres. * Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support bespoke software solutions, integrations, and applications for Anthesis clients.

* Contribute to solution estimations, project planning activities, and technical risk assessments.
* Assist in mentoring junior developers and sharing knowledge across the wider development team.
* Research, evaluate, and recommend new technologies, tools, and development approaches that enhance service delivery and product quality.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 years working knowledge \& experience with .NET Core and/or .NET Framework, or other enterprise grade applications using modern Microsoft technologies.
* Fixing and improving existing software within a professional environment.
* Experience with working in a multi\-customer environment.
* Experience working with Visual Studio, NetBeans (IFS Developer Studio), Visual Studio Code, and managing GIT repositories.
* Extensive experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically Angular, is highly desirable.
* Used and have developed CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments with automated testing.
* Use of AI and similar tools to enhance productivity in a safe manor.
* ERP integration experience (IFS, Infor M3\) is desirable.

**Skills Required**

* Analytical \& problem\-solving skills for solving complex software bugs and feature requests.
* Microsoft Azure including DevOps, APIs, Web Apps or equivalent.
* High knowledge of SQL, C\# and JavaScript (Typescript), JSON, XML, and PowerShell.
* Knowledge of Java, Python and VBA is desirable.
* Data analysis \& interpretation.
* Understands best practise design patterns in areas such as security, access control, and code maintainability.
* Web and integration technologies like RESTful and SOAP.
* Familiar with Agile and Waterfall development methodologies.
* Ability to learn new languages and technologies.
* IFS technical, PL/SQL within Oracle Databases, SQL Server is desirable.

**Qualifications**

* Educated to degree level or equivalent with at least 3 years work experience in a software developer type role.
* Demonstrable portfolio of commercial software development projects or publicly available Git or SVN repositories.
* Microsoft Certification in Azure Developer, Fundamentals and DevOps engineer is highly desirable.
* IFS Integration Developer Certification is desirable.

* Work from home

jobs.title: Heat pump engineer/plumber
jobs.description:
Are you looking for the next step in your career and want to make a positive impact on the climate? Installio is on the hunt for an enthusiastic individual to join us as a Heat Pump Engineer, joining our experienced team ready to help tackle the UK’s net\-zero transition.


Installio is building the platform powering the next generation of clean energy installations across the UK.


Working with leading energy brands including **E.ON Next, Good Energy, Aira and So Energy**, we deliver heat pumps, solar and home electrification to homes across the country.

**Tasks**
---------


Working directly in customers’ homes, you will be an intrinsic member of our heat pump team, tackling reactive maintenance and call outs, and conducting annual services. Prior experience with heat pumps is a must and you already have the skills needed to fault find and support our installation engineers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support our heat pump team solve remedials and call outs
* Conduct annual services for heat pumps
* Support install teams where necessary (Fault finding, commissioning, etc)
* Ensure customer satisfaction through high\-quality service

**Your profile**
----------------

**Required**:

* NVQ level 2 or 3 in Plumbing
* G3 Unvented
* WRAS Water Regulations
* Experience fitting heat pumps
* Experience installing pipework (solder \& press) for unvented cylinders and radiators
* Experience decommissioning heating systems
* Valid driver's license with 6 points or less

**Desirable but not necessary**:

* Gas safe
* Level 3 heat pump qualifications

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary of £42,000\+ OTE
* Pension plan
* Company vehicle and top\-of\-the\-range Milwaukee tools
* Modern and inspiring work environment
* 28 days of holidays per annum (incl. national holidays)
* Uniform and all PPE


Apply Today and Grow with Installio!

jobs.title: Civil Project Engineer
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office or on site. Office locations \- Glasgow, Aberdeen, Perth, Inverness


**Salary:** £51,600 \- £77,400 \+ car / car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available



**The role**



SSEN Transmission Onshore AC are currently recruiting for an experienced Civil Project Engineer to support our growing portfolio of projects throughout the delivery of high profile, high value and technically complex projects on the Electricity Transmission network in Scotland.



The role is responsible for taking projects from initial development and design, through to delivery, commissioning and hand over to operations.


**You will**



* Develop and deliver civil engineering solutions across some of the UK's largest transmission and substation projects, helping enable the transition to a low\-carbon energy future.
* Support the development of engineering designs from concept through to construction and commissioning, covering areas such as site development, earthworks, drainage, access arrangements and associated infrastructure.
* Define engineering scopes, prepare technical specifications, evaluate tenders and manage specialist engineering services to support successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams throughout the project lifecycle, contributing to design reviews, engineering assurance, HAZID and risk assessment activities, and the resolution of complex technical challenges.
* Promote a strong safety culture by applying CDM requirements, engineering standards and industry best practice, while identifying and managing engineering risks and opportunities.


**You have**


* A degree, HND, or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering, or substantial relevant industry experience, supported by strong technical knowledge of industry standards, specifications, and the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations (CDM).
* Experience developing and delivering civil engineering solutions for major infrastructure, utilities, energy, construction or industrial projects.
* A strong understanding of civil engineering principles including earthworks, drainage, geotechnical and structural engineering, together with knowledge of relevant design standards, regulations and engineering assurance processes.
* Experience working across multidisciplinary teams, using digital engineering tools and engaging effectively with stakeholders to support project delivery.
* The ability to manage technical risk and support engineering decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle. For Senior Civil Engineer opportunities, you'll also have experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and leading complex engineering workstreams.


We welcome applications from candidates both within and outside the electricity transmission industry. If you have transferable skills and experience from sectors such as utilities, infrastructure, construction, energy, transportation, industrial projects or the built environment, we'd love to hear from you.



**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact shirley\-anne.o'connor@sse.com / 01738 351976 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office or on site. Office locations \- Glasgow, Aberdeen, Perth, Inverness


**Salary:** £51,600 \- £77,400 \+ car / car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available



**The role**



SSEN Transmission Onshore AC are currently recruiting for an experienced Civil Project Engineer to support our growing portfolio of projects throughout the delivery of high profile, high value and technically complex projects on the Electricity Transmission network in Scotland.



The role is responsible for taking projects from initial development and design, through to delivery, commissioning and hand over to operations.


**You will**



* Develop and deliver civil engineering solutions across some of the UK's largest transmission and substation projects, helping enable the transition to a low\-carbon energy future.
* Support the development of engineering designs from concept through to construction and commissioning, covering areas such as site development, earthworks, drainage, access arrangements and associated infrastructure.
* Define engineering scopes, prepare technical specifications, evaluate tenders and manage specialist engineering services to support successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams throughout the project lifecycle, contributing to design reviews, engineering assurance, HAZID and risk assessment activities, and the resolution of complex technical challenges.
* Promote a strong safety culture by applying CDM requirements, engineering standards and industry best practice, while identifying and managing engineering risks and opportunities.


**You have**


* A degree, HND, or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering, or substantial relevant industry experience, supported by strong technical knowledge of industry standards, specifications, and the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations (CDM).
* Experience developing and delivering civil engineering solutions for major infrastructure, utilities, energy, construction or industrial projects.
* A strong understanding of civil engineering principles including earthworks, drainage, geotechnical and structural engineering, together with knowledge of relevant design standards, regulations and engineering assurance processes.
* Experience working across multidisciplinary teams, using digital engineering tools and engaging effectively with stakeholders to support project delivery.
* The ability to manage technical risk and support engineering decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle. For Senior Civil Engineer opportunities, you'll also have experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and leading complex engineering workstreams.


We welcome applications from candidates both within and outside the electricity transmission industry. If you have transferable skills and experience from sectors such as utilities, infrastructure, construction, energy, transportation, industrial projects or the built environment, we'd love to hear from you.



**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact shirley\-anne.o'connor@sse.com / 01738 351976 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.description:
Job Code: 14911
Country: GB
City: London
Skill Category: IT\\Technology
Description:
**Job Title:** Senior Java Developer – Rates Intraday Risk Technology


**Corporate Title**: Associate


**Department:**Information Technology


**Location:** London (Hybrid)

  

**Company overview**

  

  

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East \& West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.

  

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com  

  

  



**Department Overview:**

  

  

The Onyx Risk platform is used by the global Flow Rates trading desks to view their intraday risk and P\&L. There is an ongoing program of work to update the system with new trader requirements and adapt to market changes, as well as a long\-term strategic re\-architecture/modernisation program to support additional businesses and increased volumes.

  

The Rates Intraday Risk development team is a global team co\-located with the major trading centres in Tokyo, London and New York.

  

**Role Description:**

  

  

The successful candidate will be expected to:  

  

  



* Work closely with the Flow Rates trading desks and quants to analyse business requirements and provide solutions to address traders’ needs.
* Work as part of the global Onyx Risk team to develop and maintain the various server\-side processes and APIs that form a critical part of the system providing intraday risk and P\&L to the Rates business.
* Contribute towards the strategic re\-architecture/modernisation of the platform from design through to implementation and rollout.
  

**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:**

  

Mandatory:


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experienced Java developer with good knowledge of Java frameworks (Spring) and an understanding of the stages of the software development lifecycle, version control, unit testing and build tools (JUnit, Maven, Jenkins, Git).
* Experience developing tools for the front office and familiarity with financial products (preferably interest rate products) and market risk concepts.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and strong personal initiative
  

Preferred:


* Python, Docker, Kubernetes and/or AWS experience would be beneficial.
* Exposure and interest in using AI coding tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot
  

**Nomura Leadership Behaviours**

  

* **Explore Insights \& Vision:** Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.
* **Making Strategic Decisions**: Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.
* **Inspire Entrepreneurship in People**: Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.
* **Elevate Organizational Capability**: Engage proactively in professional development and enhance team productivity through the promotion of knowledge sharing.
* **Inclusion**: Respect DEI, foster a culture of inclusion and psychological safety in the workplace and cultivate a "Risk Culture" (Challenge, Escalate and Respect).
  

**Right to Work**

  

  

The UK Government have taken steps to reduce net migration to the UK by limiting the number of overseas workers coming to the UK for employment. Please note that whilst we are able to consider applications from overseas workers from outside the UK (who require a Tier 2 Skilled Worker visa) we can only employ them if we can provide evidence that this is a genuine vacancy for a qualified role.

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**

  

  

Nomura is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to ensuring we best reflect the diversity of the communities we serve creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. We welcome all applications and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnership, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.


If you require any assistance or reasonable adjustments due to a disability or long\-term health condition, please do not hesitate to contact us.

  

***Nomura is an Equal Opportunity Employer***

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Salary:** **£45,000 to £55,000 dependent upon experience.**  

**Location:** **Northallerton, Durham or Otley, with hybrid working**  

**Contract:** **Permanent, Full Time**  

**Benefits:** **25 days holiday plus bank holidays and flexi time, company pension and other benefits.**


Are you a Mechanical Building Services Engineer looking to take the next step in your career at Senior level?


Due to our continued steady expansion, we have the opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Building Services Engineer to bring their experience, professionalism, and enthusiasm to the Building Services team at Align Property Services.


**What Our Team Has Been Working On**


Our Building Services team has recently delivered a series of rapid‑response mechanical and electrical projects for Durham County Council, supporting their drive toward net‑zero carbon and improved building performance. Working across a diverse estate of schools, leisure facilities, libraries, and community buildings, we’ve managed everything from early‑stage feasibility studies to major electrical and mechanical upgrades.


Through the NEPO Mechanical and Electrical Framework, the team successfully delivered ten projects, including schemes at Consett Branch Library, Coxhoe Active Life, Copeland Road Primary School, Shotton Primary Swimming Pool, Delves Lane Primary, Villa Real School, and Rookhope Primary. These projects involved integrating renewable and energy‑efficient technologies such as solar PV, air source heat pumps, low‑energy lighting, fire alarm upgrades, and modernised heating and electrical systems which were all completed with minimal disruption to essential services.


Every commission was delivered on time and to a high standard, improving building usability, reducing energy consumption, and directly supporting the council’s sustainability objectives. If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape sustainable, impactful building services projects like these, we’d love to hear from you!


**As a Senior Mechanical Engineer**


You will be responsible for providing a variety of services including those relating to building pathology, design, project management, building surveys and contract administration as well as producing early design advice through to detailed mechanical services design.


**As part of working on larger scale projects, your day\-to\-day work will include:**


* Mechanical design from concept to detail
* Project management and contract administration
* Providing early\-stage design advice and technical consultancy
* Managing complex workloads and promote collaboration across disciplines
* Deliver smart, cost\-effective solutions that meet client expectations.
* Offering advice on Health \& Safety, fire safety, and sustainability throughout the design and construction phases, ensuring compliance with CDM regulations and best practice standards.

**What we are looking for**


* Hold a Degree or HNC in Building Services/Mechanical Engineering and ideally working towards MCIBSE.
* Have significant industry experience working as a Mechanical Engineer.
* Be able to produce Mechanical Building Services design calculations using a wide range of techniques including industry standard software such as Hevacomp and IES.
* Create feasibility reports, condition surveys, design specifications and drawings suitable for all RIBA work stages.
* Supervise the installation of building services systems, undertaking commissioning management and specifying maintenance and operating procedures.
* Carry out project design and complete H\&S risk assessments to meet current CDM regulation requirements.
* Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suite, Autodesk AutoCAD and NBS software.
* Demonstrate knowledge of NEC and JCT contracts.

For a full outline of the requirements for the role, please view the job description.


**What we can offer you:**


When you join Align, you will join a team of professionals who feel rewarded for the work they do. Operating in a friendly and professional environment, we want to provide the training and resources to succeed and thrive in your role. Our people are not just numbers, everyone is crucial to the vital services we provide, and we treat everyone in our teams with respect and complete support.


**In return for your commitment, we offer:**


* A Competitive salary up to £55,000 per year, dependent on your skills and experience
* Enrolment on to a company pension scheme which we will contribute to up 6%
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays with opportunity to purchase up to 10 additional annual leave days per leave year.
* Hybrid working to support you in a healthy work\-life balance.
* Professional development through varying project work

A benefits scheme which includes a good maternity leave package, cycle2work scheme and our online voucher portal giving access to discounts from leading retailers to help you* on shopping, days out, or nights in.
* Stability in your role \- public sector security in a private sector industry

**How to Apply**


To apply, please complete the application form and attach your CV.


The deadline for applications is Midnight on **Sunday 25th October 2026\.**


To discuss this position in more detail, or for any other questions, please get in touch with Devon Lowe (Recruitment \& Talent Partner) on 07720869014 or devon.lowe@northyorks.gov.uk


*Interviews are planned to take place throughout the recruitment process, if you would like to apply, please do so now and we will respond to you quickly. We reserve the right to remove this vacancy in the event of the position being filled before the proposed deadline.*


  
Senior Mechanical Engineer
Salary: £45,000 \- £55,000
Posted: 29/09/2026
Closing date: 25/10/2026
Closing time: 23:59 (GMT)

jobs.title: Software / Systems Developer
jobs.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen within the Systems Development Team for an experienced full stack developer, Microsoft o365 (including Power platform), RPA specialist and/or Azure DevOps expert to join an agile team.
  
  

Strong Microsoft Visual Studio skills, Azure DevOps, SQL, C\#, RPA or o365 and Power Platform
  
  

You will design and develop highly complex web based applications working across the full development lifecycle from requirements through to delivery, in an agile environment, moving towards increasing automation and DevOps.
  
  

Educated to Degree level or able to provide evidence of equivalent experience in relevant roles, you will have excellent communication skills to complement your technical and analytical skill set to drive forward the agenda for a busy and changing service.
  
  

The service area covers the following;
  
  

Bespoke application development using Visual Studio, C\#, JQuery, SQL, Blazor, and related technologies
  
  

Azure DevOps
  
  

SharePoint 365
  
  

RPA Power Automate
  
  

BottomLine TransForm / FormScape development
  
  

Systems Integration, APIs
  
  

Azure, o365
  
  

Microsoft Power Platform
  
  

If you have expertise in any of these areas above this may be the ideal role for you.
  
  

The post holder will manage their own workload whilst supporting other developers in the team and will be expected to participate in training and personal development activities.
  
  

To be effective in this role you will be familiar with a range of tools, technologies and techniques, utilising Agile development methods. You will work independently within the team, being proactive, collaborating with colleagues and adapting to changing circumstances and demands. You will be an excellent communicator who has worked in an Agile environment focused on delivery. You will be confident in working with users and using a variety of development tools and techniques and be committed to quality and continuous improvement.
  
  

Excellent troubleshooting skills and software development practices required.
  
  

Liverpool University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust comprises Aintree University Hospital, Broadgreen Hospital \& Royal Liverpool University Hospital.
  
  

We are part of NHS University Hospitals of Liverpool Group, formed on 1 Nov 2024 from the coming together of LUHFT and Liverpool Women’s NHS Foundation Trust. The Group was born from a shared aim to improve the care we provide our patients.
  
  

UHLG is one of the largest employers in the region, with over 16,800 colleagues dedicated to caring for our communities \- from birth and beyond.
  
  

For the 630,000 people across Merseyside, we are their local NHS. We provide general and emergency hospital care, alongside highly specialised regional services for more than two million people in the North West.
  
  

Aintree University Hospital is the single receiving site for adult major trauma patients in Cheshire and Merseyside and hosts a number of regional services including an award\-winning stroke facility. Broadgreen Hospital is home to elective surgical, diagnostic and treatment services, together with specialist patient rehabilitation. Liverpool Women’s Hospital specialises in the health of women and babies, delivering over 7,200 babies in the UK’s largest single site maternity hospital each year. The Royal Liverpool University Hospital is the largest hospital in the country to provide inpatients with 100% single bedrooms and focuses on complex planned care and specialist services.
  
  

For roles at Liverpool Women’s, visit their careers page .
  
  

The aim of the Software / Systems Development Team is to provide a customer orientated service to meet the business requirements of LUHFT, in line with the local and national IM\&T priorities. This service includes application design, development, and support to all partner organisations.
  
  

This challenging post will require the post holder under some, as needed, direction to design, develop, code, test, support, deploy applications to provide services to meet the Trust’s IM\&T and business needs within deadlines.
  
  

You’ll will finding simple, maintainable solutions to problems.
  
  

You’ll have a working level of knowledge of the technology stack across front\-end / back\-end and may prefer back\-end, 365 or full\-stack development.
  
  

You’ll thrive using agile methods and work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  
  

You’ll be familiar with modern frameworks, languages, and tools, as well as working practices such as test\-driven development, continuous integration, and regular production deployments.
  
  

You’ll have good communication skills and take ownership of seeing tasks through to production.

**You will**



\- Be responsible for Civil Engineering design and delivery on assigned projects of typical capital value £200M \- £2B.


* Provide technical input for your specialist discipline as well as interfacing with other technical and project functions to ensure a co\-ordinated approach to project delivery and identification and resolution of key risks.


* Promote and manage safety within assigned projects through the implementation of CDM procedures and safety in design as part of your role as Civil Project Engineer. Fulfilling the role of Designer or Principal Designer under CDM.


* Take responsibility for defining scope of civil engineering design and validation and verification of civil engineering designs. Providing ongoing civil engineering support during delivery stages of assigned projects including dealing with RFIs, TQs and PMIs.

* Provide site support as required during the construction phase including site supervision, resolution of design/construction issues and identification of non\-conformances/quality issues and close out of issues.


**You have**


* A degree in an appropriate engineering discipline (preferably CEng or working towards this).


* Demonstrable experience of using digital platforms (Infraworks, Civil 3D, Revit, Navisworks etc.) to facilitate engineering design development and ensure design coordination with other disciplines.


* Good technical knowledge of industry standards, design codes, technical specifications, and how to determine applicability of relevant standards.


* An understanding of CDM Regulations and be proactive in the resolution of issues which affect the constructability of works on site.


* An ability to communicate complex technical issues in a clear and concise manner to facilitate decision making by senior management.


* An appreciation for working in multi\-discipline project teams and enthusiasm to learn about other disciplines and their role in project development and delivery.


* A desire to be involved in both the project development and project delivery aspects of large capital projects with opportunities to be involved in projects from concept to completion.

jobs.title: Associate Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Reporting to: Director / Associate Director (Building Services)  

  



Team: Building Services Engineering  

  



Location: Sidcup / London / Remote

  

  

  

**Associate Mechanical Design Engineer**

  

Job Specification


Reporting to: Director / Associate Director (Building Services)
  

Team: Building Services Engineering
  

Location: Sidcup, London, Remote
  

  

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate Mechanical Design Engineer to join
  

our Building Services team.
  

  

This is a senior technical and leadership position responsible for managing the design and delivery of
  

mechanical building services projects, leading project teams, developing client relationships, and
  

contributing to the growth and success of the business.
  

  

The successful candidate will combine excellent technical knowledge with strong commercial
  

awareness and leadership skills, ensuring projects are delivered to the highest standards whilst
  

supporting the development of engineers within the team.  

  



  

Main Responsibilities


**Technical Design \& Project Delivery**  

• Lead the mechanical design of building services projects from concept through to completion.
  

* Undertake the role of Lead Mechanical Engineer on projects of varying size and complexity.
* Prepare, review and approve calculations, specifications, reports, schedules and design

drawings.
  

* Produce high\-quality technical designs for HVAC, heating, cooling, ventilation, public health

and renewable energy systems.
  

* Ensure designs comply with current legislation, Building Regulations, British Standards, CIBSE

guidance and client requirements.
  

* Manage project deliverables, programmes and design resources.
* Undertake site inspections, condition surveys and design review meetings.
* Review contractor proposals, technical submissions and commissioning documentation.
* Coordinate with other engineering disciplines, architects, contractors and stakeholders.
* Support sustainable and low\-carbon design solutions in line with current industry best practice.
  

  

**Team Leadership \& Development**

* Mentor, support and develop Mechanical Engineers, Senior Engineers and Technicians.
* Undertake technical reviews and quality checks of design information.
* Lead recruitment, mentoring, appraisal and development of engineering staff within the team.
* Support engineers working towards professional accreditation and chartership.
* Promote a collaborative, positive and high\-performing team culture.

  

  

**Commercial Responsibilities**

* Manage project budgets, fee expenditure and programme performance.
* Monitor project profitability and resource utilisation.
* Assist in fee proposal preparation and scope definition.


Associate Mechanical Design Engineer  

  



  

  

  

* Identify and manage project risks, opportunities and variations.
* Support the achievement of departmental financial targets.
* Contribute to workload forecasting and resource planning.
* Support achievement of annual team utilisation and fee targets.
* Lead preparation of fee proposals and framework submissions.
* Identify new business opportunities with existing and prospective clients.


**Client \& Business Management**  

• Develop and maintain strong client relationships.
  

* Attend client meetings and provide professional technical advice.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional services.
* Assist with framework submissions, tenders and fee proposals.
* Support business development initiatives and networking opportunities.
* Act as a positive ambassador for the business.
  

  

**Quality, Compliance \& Health \& Safety**

* Ensure compliance with company procedures and quality management systems.
* Promote safe design principles in accordance with CDM regulations.
* Maintain awareness of current legislation, standards and industry developments.
* Ensure project documentation is produced and issued in accordance with company standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the mechanical engineering team.

  

  

**Leadership \& Team Management**

* Lead and manage a team of Mechanical Engineers and Technicians.
* Undertake annual appraisals and probation reviews.
* Support resource planning and workload allocation.
* Promote knowledge sharing and technical excellence.
* Support succession planning within the team.

  

  

Candidate Specification


**Essential Experience**

* Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related

discipline.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) and Member of CIBSE, IMechE or equivalent professional

institution.
* Significant experience within a Building Services Consultancy environment.
* Strong technical knowledge of building services design.
* Proven experience leading mechanical design projects.
* Excellent understanding of: HVAC Systems, Heating Systems, Cooling Systems, Ventilation


Systems, Public Health Engineering, Renewable Energy Technologies.
  

* Proficiency with industry standard design software.
* Strong communication and report\-writing skills.
* Excellent project management and organisational abilities.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of project financial management.

Associate Mechanical Design Engineer  

  



  

  

**Desirable Experience**

* Member of CIBSE, IMechE or equivalent professional institution.
* Experience delivering projects using BIM and Revit workflows.
* Knowledge of BREEAM, NABERS and Net Zero design principles.
* Experience across residential, education, healthcare, commercial and public\-sector projects.

  

  

**Key Attributes**

* Technical excellence
* Leadership \& mentoring
* Project management
* Commercial awareness
* Client relationship management
* Communication skills
* Problem solving
* Decision making
* Planning \& organisation
* Business development


Benefits \& Initiatives


Frankham offer excellent benefits and initiatives, including:
  

* Hybrid working policy
* Annual leave \- sell, buy \& carry\-over
* Health Insurance \- Health Shield cash plan
* Long service award
* Incentive scheme
* Frankham Friday
* Professional qualification support
* Cycle\-to\-work scheme
* Death in service
* Annual season ticket loan
* Generous maternity \& paternity pay
  

  

  

About Frankham Group


Frankham is a top 50 multi\-disciplinary built environment consultancy. For over 40 years, we have
  

delivered integrated Design, Surveying and Project Management, Infrastructure Engineering, and Risk
  

Management solutions to the built environment. We combine technical expertise with a commitment
  

to bringing ideas to life.
  

  

Following investment by LDC in March 2026, Frankham Group is entering a pivotal phase of
  

growth and transformation. The business is evolving from a collection of highly entrepreneurial
  

divisions into a more connected, scalable and strategically aligned organisation capable of
  

delivering accelerated growth, operational excellence and long\-term value creation.  

  



Associate Mechanical Design Engineer  

  



  

  

  

As part of this next stage of development, we are seeking an experienced and commercially astute
  

legal professional to establish, lead and develop the Group's legal function. The successful candidate
  

will provide strategic and operational legal leadership across all areas of the business, supporting
  

commercial growth whilst ensuring legal, contractual and regulatory risks are effectively managed.
  

  

Acting as a trusted adviser to the Board, Executive Leadership Team and operational management
  

teams, the role will play a pivotal part in protecting and enhancing the Group's interests, enabling
  

sustainable growth and supporting key strategic initiatives including acquisitions, business integration
  

and market expansion.


Associate Mechanical Design Engineer

Senior Test Engineer


We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Engineer to support the delivery of complex cloud transformation and modernisation programmes.


This is a hands\-on role focused on quality engineering and test automation across legacy, hybrid and cloud\-native environments. You will work closely with engineering, architecture and delivery teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.

* Experience testing cloud\-based applications and services.

* Ability to work closely with developers, architects and other technical specialists.

* Testing during legacy\-to\-cloud transformation or application modernisation.

**Reports to:** Service Manager

This role offers a great opportunity for an experienced Engineer. You will play a key role in supporting the After Market Service Department by performing maintenance and repairs on customer\-owned diesel generators. The successful candidate will also be responsible for the maintenance, inspection, testing, calibration, and operation of the company’s load bank fleet, ensuring all equipment is maintained to the highest standards and available to support customer and operational requirements.

* Carry out planned servicing, maintenance, repair, and refurbishment of customer\-owned generator sets within the workshop.
* Diagnose and rectify mechanical, electrical, and control system faults on diesel\-powered generating equipment.
* Prepare customer equipment for inspection, testing, commissioning, and return to service.
* Conduct engine, alternator, control panel, and ancillary equipment inspections.

**Role** : Senior C\+\+ SW Developer.  



**The opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced R\&D Software Developer focused on C\+\+ application development for performance‑critical systems to join our technology organization.  



In this role, you will develop, high\-performance, and secure software systems built with modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\), with a strong focus on real\-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.  



As an R\&D Software Developer within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.


You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting\-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real\-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long\-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.  



We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.  



  

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Develop system design in areas like multithreading, synchronization, I/O, and latency requirements for real\-time operation.
* Develop high\-performance C\+\+ cores to managed runtime services (.NET, RUST) with minimal latency overhead.
* Implement performance optimization and scalability: profile threading behavior, minimizing lock contention, reducing memory allocations in critical paths, and ensure predictable latency at scale.
* Practical usage of modern programming practices and techniques based on the latest C\+\+ standard.
* Maintain high code quality through code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to SOLID, KISS, DRY and industry best practices.
* Participate in system design, best practices and maintaining code quality in performance\-critical sections.
* Participate in technical architecture reviews, design documentation, and roadmaps for feature development, refactoring initiatives, and legacy code modernization.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transform requirements into clear architectural designs.
* Support strategic technology decisions on dependencies, build tooling, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices.
* Maintain cross\-platform support: drive modernization of build systems, ensure consistency across multiple deployment environments, and support Linux/Windows compatibility.
* Practical Linux development and deployment strategies.
* Contribute to achieving business goals by designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality software solutions.
* Continuously enhance existing systems and contribute to the creation of new features.
* Work effectively within an agile environment, continually expanding your technical expertise and understanding of the business domain.
Actively participate in a cross\-disciplinary team and contribute to shared objectives.  
* 

**Your Background:**

* University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience in senior technical roles.
* Advanced proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) with deep understanding of RAII, smart pointers, STL, concurrency, and memory management.
* Practical knowledge of C\# development in plus.
* Strong experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real\-time system design.
* Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross\-platform development for Windows and Linux.
* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture patterns.
* Demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low\-latency systems.
* Understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
* Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
* Knowledge of non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
* Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring having familiarity with WAMS/WAMPAC, PMU data, and protection and control applications.
* Understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards.
* Experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU) in plus.
* Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC 61850, IEC\-60870\-5\-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37\.118\) in plus.

jobs.title: Senior Animation Engineer | Unity3D | Remote | Stylized Games
jobs.description:
**Senior Animation Engineer \| Unity3D \| Remote \| Stylized Games**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Position Overview**


Beffio is looking for an experienced **Senior Animation Engineer** to join a major game project developed in Unity3D.


This role sits between **Animation, Technical Art, and Engineering**, focusing on the technology, runtime systems, and tools behind high\-quality character animation.


We are looking for someone who understands animation as both a creative workflow and a technical system. You should be comfortable working with animators on controllers, rigs, and pipelines while also discussing runtime architecture, ECS/DOTS, GPU skinning, shaders, performance, and C\# implementation with engineers.


This is a senior individual contributor role with significant **R\&D and technical ownership**, taking ideas from early prototypes through production\-ready systems that can be used and maintained by the wider team.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and optimize animation runtime systems in Unity.
* Work with state machines, blend trees, layers, masks, root motion, animation events, and compression.
* Develop or integrate data\-oriented animation solutions using ECS/DOTS, Jobs, Burst, and baking workflows.
* Explore GPU skinning, deformation, compute shaders, vertex shaders, and vertex animation techniques.
* Build Unity editor tools, validators, asset processors, and production workflows for animation teams.
* Support rigging, skeleton, skinning, and FBX workflows between Maya or Blender and Unity.
* Profile and optimize animation systems across mobile hardware.
* Collaborate closely with Animators, Technical Artists, Gameplay Engineers, and Rendering Engineers.
* Take technical R\&D from prototype to production\-ready feature.
* Establish clean documentation, workflows, and technical standards for the wider team.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Strong **C\# and Unity** engineering experience.
* Hands\-on experience with **ECS/DOTS**, including Entities, Burst, Jobs, and baking, or deep equivalent data\-oriented engine experience.
* Strong understanding of animation runtimes including state machines, blend trees, layers, masks, root motion, events, and animation compression.
* Experience with GPU skinning and deformation using structured or constant buffers, compute shaders, vertex shaders, or similar techniques.
* Shader development experience in **HLSL** and a node\-based tool such as Shader Graph or Amplify.
* Practical knowledge of character rigs, skeletons, skinning, and FBX pipelines in Maya, Blender, or similar tools.
* Experience creating Unity editor tools such as asset postprocessors, validators, custom inspectors, or editor windows.
* Experience profiling and optimizing mobile graphics workloads, particularly on Adreno and Mali hardware.
* Familiarity with GLES and Vulkan.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both artists and engineers.
* Fluent English.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with DOTS animation frameworks such as **Rukhanka, Latios Kinemation**, or similar technology.
* Experience building or extending a custom animation runtime.
* Networked animation involving prediction and rollback.
* Netcode for Entities or similar multiplayer technology.
* Procedural animation including IK, secondary motion, or physics\-driven layers.
* Facial animation systems using blendshapes, bones, textures, or hybrid approaches.
* Crowd animation systems including animation LOD, VAT, or update throttling.
* Experience developing animation systems for mobile or other performance\-constrained platforms.

**Ownership**
-------------


We are looking for someone who can:

* Take R\&D from an initial technical spike through to a shipped production feature.
* Independently drive complex technical investigations and make pragmatic architectural decisions.
* Balance animation quality, performance, complexity, and usability.
* Create systems and standards that others can confidently build upon.
* Be equally comfortable reviewing an animator's controller and an engineer's pull request.
* Work closely with artists rather than treating animation as purely an engineering problem.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Meaningful ownership over animation technology on a major Unity3D game project.
* Direct collaboration with experienced Animators, Technical Artists, Engineers, and discipline leads.
* The opportunity to work on complex technical R\&D and turn it into production systems.
* A highly collaborative international team.
* Fully remote work.
* Flexible contract options depending on location.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and contract structure.
* Annual Beffio team retreats.
* The possibility of long\-term collaboration as the project grows.

**Senior VFX Engineer \| Unity3D \| Remote**
--------------------------------------------

### **Position Overview**


Beffio is looking for an experienced **Senior VFX Engineer** to join a major game project developed in Unity3D.


This role sits between **VFX, Technical Art, Rendering, and Engineering**, focusing on the technology and scalable runtime systems behind real\-time effects.


We are looking for someone who can take a question like *"can we make it look like this?"* and turn the visual idea into a solution that is performant, reusable, artist\-friendly, and scalable across a large game.


You will work closely with VFX Artists and Engineers on shaders, particles, GPU\-driven effects, runtime architecture, tooling, mobile optimization, and gameplay integration.


This is a senior individual contributor role with significant technical ownership, where you will be expected to prototype solutions, make architectural decisions, and take systems through to production.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop scalable runtime systems for high\-frequency gameplay effects.
* Build solutions for pooling, shared emitters, batching, prioritization, and effect budgets.
* Develop shaders using **HLSL**, Shader Graph, Amplify, or similar tools.
* Work with particle systems, mesh particles, trails, flipbooks, procedural effects, and GPU\-driven techniques.
* Build artist\-facing Unity tools, validators, custom inspectors, asset processors, and batch workflows.
* Optimize effects for mobile GPUs, memory, overdraw, shader complexity, and runtime performance.
* Collaborate with VFX Artists, Technical Artists, Gameplay Engineers, and Rendering Engineers.
* Prototype new technical approaches and take successful solutions through to production.
* Establish reusable templates, documentation, and technical standards for the VFX team.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Strong **HLSL shader programming** experience.
* Fluency with node\-based tools such as Shader Graph, Amplify, or similar.
* Strong understanding of real\-time rendering including blending, transparency, sorting, depth, instancing, and scriptable or custom render pipelines.
* Experience shipping particle\-based effects in Unity using Shuriken or equivalent systems.
* Experience with mesh particles, trails, flipbooks, and shader\-driven effects.
* Experience designing scalable effect runtimes for high\-frequency effects, including pooling, batching, prioritization, or budget management.
* Strong C\# gameplay or engine programming experience.
* Experience with ECS/DOTS, Jobs, Burst, or equivalent performance\-focused architecture is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of mobile GPU optimization including overdraw, half precision, texture budgets, memory, and shader variants.
* Unity editor tooling experience including custom inspectors, drawers, asset processors, or batch tools.
* Understanding of **Metal, Vulkan, and GLES**, including platform\-specific graphics limitations and shader or PSO warmup.
* Strong communication skills across both artistic and engineering disciplines.
* Fluent English.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Strong Unity DOTS/Entities experience.
* Experience with ECS\-based rendering or instanced material properties.
* Compute shaders and GPU\-driven effects.
* Vertex animation techniques.
* SDFs, procedural noise, and procedural rendering.
* Experience with procedural or voxel geometry, dynamic meshes, hull generation, or custom lighting systems.
* Networked gameplay effects including predicted versus confirmed events.
* Experience with multiplayer or large\-scale gameplay systems.
* Strong artistic eye and ability to participate in VFX look development.
* Experience building effects for mobile or other performance\-constrained platforms.

**Ownership**
-------------


We are looking for someone who can:

* Act as a bridge between **artists and engineers**.
* Independently turn creative requests into workflows and technology that scale.
* Prototype solutions quickly, validate them technically, and take them through to production.
* Make informed technical decisions balancing visual ambition with runtime performance.
* Review and improve systems created by others.
* Leave behind clean systems, templates, documentation, and standards that make the whole team more effective.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Meaningful ownership over the technology powering VFX on a major Unity3D game project.
* Direct collaboration with experienced VFX Artists, Technical Artists, Rendering Engineers, and Gameplay Engineers.
* The opportunity to solve challenging rendering and performance problems.
* A role where engineering directly enables creative ambition.
* A highly collaborative international team.
* Fully remote work.
* Flexible contract options depending on location.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and contract structure.
* Annual Beffio team retreats.
* The possibility of long\-term collaboration as the project grows.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Credit & Fraud
jobs.description:
##### **What we do at Qliro**


At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

##### **What your team does**


We are now looking for a **Software Engineer** to join Credit \& Fraud team, the team at the center of Qliro’s Pay Later platform. What we do here shapes whether customers can pay in a way that actually works for them, and whether we protect them from taking on debt they can’t handle. It’s a dual responsibility, and we take both sides seriously.


We’re rebuilding the next generation of this system from the ground up, designed to handle a significant increase in transaction volumes as we scale. Part of what you’ll lead is making this platform ready to operate beyond the Nordics, so the architectural decisions you make now will need to hold up across multiple markets. We’re in the early stages of exploring how AI can help us make better credit and fraud decisions, and we’re honest that this is genuinely complex territory. Credit is one of the most regulated areas when it comes to AI: explainability, fairness, and auditability aren’t optional. We want someone who finds that complexity interesting, not someone who pretends it isn’t there.

##### **Current focus for the team**

* Processing tens of thousands of credit and fraud checks every day
* Running a containerized microservices architecture with daily production deployments
* Tech stack: C\#, .NET, AWS, Docker \+ Swarm, Kubernetes, Microservices, Event Driven Architecture, RabbitMQ, Terraform, GitLab, MS SQL Server, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenTelemetry \+ Grafana, Kibana

##### **What we are looking for**

* **3\-5 years of professional experience with .NET**, with strong skills in C\#
* Comfortable using modern AI tooling such as **Windsurf**, **Claude**, or similar
* Experience in **modernizing and migrating legacy systems**
* Practical experience with agile engineering methods and solid software engineering best practices
* Strong understanding of system design, data structures, and API development
* A mindset that values **speed, correctness, and reliability**, especially in microservices and event‑driven architectures


It is beneficial if you have experience from:

* Working with **credit engines**, **credit decisioning**, or similar financial decision systems
* Working with AWS or other cloud providers
* Working in a team with full platform ownership — including monitoring, infrastructure, CI/CD, and production operations

###### **Does this sound like your next role? What are you waiting for \- apply now!**

*Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual* orientation *or age*.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Vill du ta klivet till att bli frilansare och bygga ditt eget bolag, men med ett tryggt säkerhetsnät i ryggen? På Independtech hjälper vi erfarna personer att gå från anställning till egenföretagande i sin egen takt.

**Så fungerar det:**


Du börjar som anställd konsult hos oss och arbetar i spännande kunduppdrag i Stockholm. Samtidigt får du stöd och kunskap inom bland annat ekonomi, försäljning och hur du bygger ditt eget bolag.


Efter cirka 12 månader är tanken att du ska kunna ta steget till eget. Men det finns ingen deadline – du bestämmer själv när du är redo.


När du startar ditt eget bolag hjälper vi dig med övergången. Därefter står du helt på egna ben, utan förpliktelser gentemot oss – men med vårt nätverk kvar som bollplank.

**Kriterier för rollen:**


Vi söker dig som är verksam inom QA och testing. Vi ser gärna att du har:

* Minst 6 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet QA/Testing och/eller en bakgrund inom mjukvaruutveckling.
* Kan automatiserade tester: Har god erfarenhet av testautomatisering och vill fortsätta utvecklas vidare inom området.
* API\-testning: Har praktisk erfarenhet av att testa API:er, gärna via verktyg som ReadyAPI eller Bruno.
* Azure\-ekosystemet: Har erfarenhet av testhantering och flöden i Azure DevOps och Azure\-miljöer.
* CI/CD\-integrering: Har vana av att lägga till och köra automatiserade tester direkt i bygg\- och deployment\-pipelines (t.ex. Azure Pipelines).
* Kod\- eller skriptkunskap: Känner dig trygg med något programmerings\- eller skriptspråk (t.ex. JavaScript/TypeScript, C\# eller Python) för att bygga och underhålla testskript.
* Flytande kunskaper i svenska (i tal och skrift) och bor i Stockholmsområdet.

**Plus i kanten:**

* Erfarenhet av AI/ML eller AI\-assisterade utvecklingsverktyg.
* Tidigare erfarenhet som IT\-konsult.
* Relevant högre akademisk utbildning.

**Vill du ta det första steget mot ett friare arbetsliv?**


Skicka in din ansökan idag så startar vi resan tillsammans!

Hos oss får du friheten att själv forma din arbetssituation och tryggheten i en fast anställning.

**We don’t wait for the future. We build it.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Flight Operations - Frontend
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Operations \- Frontend As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a leading role in the development of the Avinode Flight Operations product offering. As a member of a product team made up of a Product Manager, UX Designer, Test Lead, and Software Engineers, you will plan, implement, and release business\-critical features for customers across the business aviation industry. What you will do Working together with your teammates, design appropriate technical solutions to implement new product features and improve current features. You will be working both in our existing React frontend and C\# .NET monolith as well as developing new services when needed.
  
  

Maintain and improve our React tooling and build pipeline. Work to bring our codebase up to date with current best practices, libraries, and platforms. Research and advocate for new technologies and techniques that would be beneficial to your team and/or the wider Engineering organisation. Act as a mentor to less experienced engineers as a technical resource to Avinode Group as a whole, providing information, advice, and technical assistance when requested.
  
  

Who you are You have 7\+ years of experience building frontend applications with JavaScript and React, as well as some experience with the .NET ecosystem. You are more experienced with frontend development, but you will be expected to contribute to all parts of the stack when necessary. You are comfortable both with maintaining code that uses older JavaScript technologies (we still have some JQuery and Knockout JS pages) and with migrating it to React. You have experience creating and maintaining tools for developer experience, deployment, security, automation in the NodeJS / NPM ecosystem.
  
  

You have some experience working with relational databases and some proficiency with SQL (we use MS SQL Server, but experience with Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, etc. is fine). You have a proven track record of leading projects, mentoring other members of your team, and researching and integrating new tools and technologies into your work. You are familiar with software development and delivery best practices, and know how to ensure your team is following them.
  
  

You communicate well. With offices in multiple time zones and multiple countries, this position requires strong written and verbal communication skills. What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated.
  
  

Your ideas will be heard. Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. Competitive salary and benefits Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important. Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings.
  
  

We want to support your development and dreams. Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website.
  
  

Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!
