jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Engineering Excellence
jobs.description:
**Make excellent engineering the easy path, for every squad at If CTP**


If is the biggest insurance company in the Nordics: thousands of skilled colleagues keeping everyday life running for millions of customers, their homes, cars, businesses and more. Behind that promise stands modern engineering, and behind our engineers stands Engineering Excellence: a DevOps\-oriented enablement team whose product is the capability of every other squad. We are now looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to build shared platforms, coach fellow engineers, and shape safe, human\-approved agentic AI ways of working.

  

**About the role**

This is not a feature\-delivery seat, it is a multiplier role. Instead of shipping one product, you make many squads better at shipping theirs, and your definition of done includes adoption: work is finished when another team can use, own and support it.

  

Day to day, you will:


* Build and evolve our shared engineering backbone: reusable CI/CD pipelines and pipeline libraries, repository practices, platform tooling, integrations and automation on Azure and Azure DevOps.
* Establish and enable engineering standards, guardrails, and branching and naming conventions that make the right way the easy way.
* Strengthen quality and security: validation and testing enablement, software scanning, secure\-engineering practice, reliability, and actionable engineering feedback.
* Untangle material cross\-squad blockers in builds, environments, delivery and platform, making dependencies visible and handing over responsibly.
* Coach engineers and squads, support onboarding, and turn hard\-won knowledge into documentation people actually use.
* Use engineering metrics, discovery and evidence to guide continuous improvement, without overstating what the data proves.
  

You will also be hands\-on in our agentic engineering journey. We are building an AI\-assisted operating model for the team that starts deliberately read\-only and follows a strict loop: agents observe and propose, humans approve, and only then are changes applied. You will help design these proposal\-controlled workflows, the guardrails and least\-privilege access behind them, and the evidence that shows what AI adoption genuinely improves.

  

You will work across every squad rather than inside one, side by side with architects, squad technical leads, Product Management and program stakeholders. It is a rare vantage point that grows your platform depth and your influence at the same time. The team runs on Kanban flow rather than sprints: demand is clarified, work is made ready, delivered, validated, documented and handed over, with blockers made visible instead of hidden.

  

**We offer**


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits  
* 

  

**About the team**


Engineering Excellence is six engineers with one shared conviction: great enablement means the job is not done until someone else can use, own and support the outcome. We prefer evidence over assumptions, we make dependencies and risks visible instead of hiding them, and we keep egos low and trust high, coaching each other the same way we coach the squads.

  

Human accountability sits at the core of how we adopt AI: our agents may observe and propose, but people approve, and decision rights always stay with the roles that own them. If’s whole business is keeping promises when it matters most, and we hold our engineering to the same standard, reliable, secure, and easy to build on. We also live If’s customer\-centric, “undifficult” mindset internally: our customers are If’s own squads, and our job is to make their best work feel effortless. You will join an international workplace that is genuinely committed to diversity, and a team where your questions on day one are as welcome as your improvements on day one hundred.

  

**Who are you?**


You are an enabler at heart, you get real energy from making other engineers faster, safer and more confident. You communicate clearly and coach as naturally as you commit code. You are curious and evidence\-driven: you would rather measure than assume, and you separate facts from interpretation. When dependencies tangle and priorities shift, you stay calm, make the situation visible, and keep the flow moving. You treat documentation and handover as part of the craft rather than an afterthought. And whenever automation or AI touches real systems, you exercise sound judgement about access, privacy, least privilege and human approval.

  

**You also have:**


* Practical experience in DevOps, platform engineering, developer productivity or engineering enablement
* Hands\-on skills in CI/CD, Git, repository management, automation and pipeline engineering
* Experience with Azure and/or Azure DevOps
* A track record of improving quality, testing, security scanning, reliability or engineering standards
* Comfort working in a flow\-based / Kanban way, with dependencies, blockers and explicit handover
  

**It’s a plus if you also bring:**


* Development experience in .NET, Java, Kotlin or TypeScript, or full\-stack curiosity
* Experience with agentic or AI\-assisted development, and with measuring its adoption responsibly
* Work with DORA or other engineering metrics, discovery or maturity assessments
* Experience building pipeline libraries, reusable templates or repository governance at scale

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------

**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 14th of October.


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV.


**Work location:** Bergshamra


**Start:** By agreement

  

For more information, please contact Burhan Öcüt, DevOps Architect, burhan.ocut@if.se

  

Background checks may be conducted as part of the recruitment process in accordance with applicable legislation and internal policies.

  

**We look forward to your application!**

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

 **Location/Division Specific Information:**

**Olink**, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high\-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease.  

  

**Job description:**  

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Staff Data Engineer**. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions for our RnD users and processes. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries. The role is based in our Uppsala office.  



  

**A Day in the Life:**

* Build and operate on PSX analytical data processing platform in AWS
* Design and build a robust foundation for data pipelines
* Take ownership for the platform architecture, infrastructure and longevity
* Be part of our solution design group and collaborate with other dev leads (Software \& AI Data Science) to secure the best designs and architecture and ensure our tooling eco system is future proof
* Support less senior team members, foster best practices and set high standards.
* Be opportunistiskt, identify and suggest solutions for potential challenges such as performance, scalability, cost and security
* Represent the team in technical and complex cross functional matters

 **Requirements:**

* Master of Science in Molecular Biotechnology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
* Several years of working experience, Life Science experience is a plus.
* Strong experience building analytical data \& analytics platforms in cloud environments (AWS knowledge or willingness to learn AWS is required)
* Strong verbal and presentational skills
* Strong Python or C\# programming skills
* Knowledgeable in infrastructure\-as\-code (CDK/Terraform).
* Experience working with Iceberg, versioning etc.
* A product\-oriented mindset, focused on building durable, scalable solutions rather than one\-off pipelines.
* Experience in Ops/Observability, i.e building monitoring solutions.

 **Why Join Us?**


At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

  

The final date for submitting applications is on the 20th of October. The role could be filled prior to this deadline.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
* Permanent
* Experienced Professionals
* Software Engineering
* ID 568931\-en\_US
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a workplace where you are empowered to shape your career in the way you envision, where you become part of a supportive and inspiring community of engaged colleagues around the world, and where you have the opportunity to redefine what is possible. Our Cloud \& Custom Applications teams focus on developing tailored, scalable, and secure cloud applications, integrating IT systems, and driving business transformation. AI is a key technology in everything we do and a central part of how we design and build modern systems and solutions. Intelligent AI\-driven ways of working and technologies such as Agentic AI are accelerating innovation and shaping the future. Join us and help shape the next generation of systems together with world\-leading organizations, while contributing to unlocking the full potential of technology in a more sustainable and inclusive world.


**.**
-----


**Your Role**


As a Platform Engineer Specialist at Capgemini, you will help clients design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and self\-service platform solutions. You will combine hands\-on engineering with platform strategy, automation, developer enablement, governance, and operational excellence.
  

Platform Engineering is becoming one of the most important disciplines in modern software development. Organisations are investing heavily in developer platforms, cloud\-native technologies, automation and AI\-enabled engineering to help teams deliver software faster, more securely and at greater scale. We are growing our Platform Engineering capability across Sweden and are looking for Platform Engineers and Senior Platform Engineers who want to help clients solve complex engineering challenges, modernise software delivery and build platforms that enable hundreds, and sometimes thousands, of developers.
  

This is a client\-facing consulting role where you will combine hands\-on engineering with architecture, automation, platform strategy and developer enablement. You will work with leading organisations across multiple industries, helping them establish modern platform capabilities that accelerate innovation while maintaining high standards for security, reliability and governance.


This is a client\-facing consulting role, and your work setup may vary between hybrid, onsite, or client\-based engagements depending on the assignment. You can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Helsingborg, Malmö, Växjö, or Älmhult.  

  

  



**In this role, you will play a key part in:**


* Design, build, and operate cloud\-native platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and OpenShift, enabling modern delivery through CI/CD, self\-service tooling, and internal developer platforms.
* Developing golden paths, reusable templates, platform APIs, and service catalogues that make it easier for engineering teams to build, deploy, and operate services.
* Driving automation and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Establishing platform standards, reference architectures and governance including platform security, identity and access management, observability, monitoring, and operational excellence.

Support clients in moving AI initiatives from experimentation to secure, scalable, production\-ready solutions.  
* 

**Your profile**


* Hands\-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related field.
* A strong understanding of modern platform engineering principles and how self\-service solutions can improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.
* Programming or scripting experience using Python, Go, C\#, Java, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Experience in applying security, governance, and responsible AI principles in an enterprise environment.
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Amazon Q, Gemini Code Assist, or similar.
* A practical understanding of modern AI concepts and patterns, including LLMs, prompting, context engineering, RAG, evaluation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* The ability to combine strategic platform thinking with hands\-on technical delivery in complex environments.

Clear communication with technical teams and client stakeholders, and an interest in working in a consulting context.  
* 

*We do not expect you to know about every technology on this list. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, hands\-on experience, and the ability to understand how infrastructure, software delivery, security, operations, and developer needs fit together*


**.**
-----


**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**


* Being part of a growing Platform Engineering capability where your expertise and ideas can make a visible impact.
* Working across diverse client environments, industries, technologies, and delivery models.
* Collaborating with skilled colleagues locally and globally, with access to strong technical communities and development opportunities.
* Contributing to initiatives within cloud, platform automation, developer enablement, and AI\-assisted engineering.

Helping clients build solutions that are secure, scalable, sustainable, and valuable in real business contexts.  
* 

**Application**  

  

We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact the responsible recruiter at Helene.yde@capgemini.com


*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.*
  

\#LI\-HY1


Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end\-to\-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market\-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22\.5 billion.


Make it real \| www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team!**


We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M\-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event\-driven microservices and help shape what AI\-native engineering looks like at M\-KOPA.

**The Impact**

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e\-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering**: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under\-banked populations


**Global recognition**: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges**: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets


**AI\-native from day one**: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on


**Fully distributed**: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C\# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event\-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes\-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end\-to\-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

**Technical Environment**

* **Modern C\# stack**: Distributed C\# and .NET microservices
* **Cloud \& orchestration**: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes
* **Architecture**: Event\-driven, supporting products used at significant scale
* **Observability**: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics
* **AI tooling**: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

**Our Engineering Approach**

* **AI\-native engineering**: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works
* **Guardrails as we accelerate**: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship
* **Own it beyond the pull request**: Design for idempotency, retries, out\-of\-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production
* **The Campfire Rule**: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them
* **On\-call as feedback, not heroics**: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

**What You Need**


We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

**Required Experience:**

* Strong grasp of C\# and .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems \- We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes
* Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour
* Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)
* DevOps culture mindset, including on\-call/production ownership
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones
* Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

**Location \& Benefits**

* Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours
* Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Personalised training budget to support your development
* Home office setup budget
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission**

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

Our technology has created measurable change:

* **Connected** : 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users connected
* **Prosperous** : 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green** : 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e\-mobility

**Ready to build C\#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real\-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

TD General

**Job Description:**

**2027 Technology Internship \- AI\-Native Data Platform Engineering \- 6\-month Internship (January – July)**

TD Securities are offering an exceptional opportunity to join a diverse and dynamic team through our 6\-month Technology Internship on the AI\- Native Data Platform Engineering team.  



**Internship Overview**

* **Contract Type:** Full\-time, 6\-Month Internship
* **Dates:** January 2027 – July 2027
* **Location:**
	+ **Dublin Office** : 1 Molesworth Street
	Candidates must have an unrestricted right to work in Ireland throughout the entire duration of the internship.  
	+

  

**Team Overview:**

The TDS Data Platform Engineering team is building the next generation of data platforms where data products, AI agents, and self\-service analytics work together to help users discover, understand, and consume data more effectively.  



  

Our mission is to provide a scalable, secure, and AI\-ready data platform that empowers domain teams to build and own data products while enabling consumers to interact with data through modern experiences such as AI agents, natural language interfaces, and intelligent automation.  



  

As a Graduate Analyst or a 6\-month Intern, you will help shape how AI and data platforms converge. You will work on technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), data products, APIs, cloud\-native platforms, and analytics solutions. You will collaborate with domain owners, data engineers, application teams, and platform engineers to create innovative solutions that make data easier to discover, understand, and use.  



  

We are a highly collaborative team that values curiosity, experimentation, continuous learning, and delivering business value through simple, scalable, and user\-centric solutions.  



  

**How you will Contribute:**

* Help design and build AI\-ready data platform capabilities that enable self\-service data discovery and usage.
* Develop AI agents and MCP\-based integrations that allow users to interact with data products using natural language.
* Collaborate with domain owners to understand their data products and create intelligent experiences that simplify data consumption.
* Build APIs, services, and automation frameworks that expose data and business capabilities to AI agents and applications.
* Contribute to the development of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise data sources.
* Assist in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and cloud\-native data services.
* Create proof\-of\-concepts exploring emerging technologies in AI, data engineering, and developer productivity.
* Partner with platform users to understand pain points and improve platform usability and adoption.
* Develop tools that help users discover datasets, understand lineage, definitions, ownership, and usage patterns.
* Support the implementation of governance, security, and access controls for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Participate in platform monitoring, troubleshooting, testing, and continuous improvement activities.
* Contribute to technical documentation, architecture reviews, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Apply engineering best practices including clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure software development.
Continuously research emerging AI and data technologies and evaluate their relevance to the platform.  
* 

  

**Key Technologies:**

* The successful graduate will gain experience in:
* AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Prompt Engineering
* Java (Spring Boot) for APIs and backend services
* Python for data engineering, automation, analytics, and AI solutions
* Apache Spark and Dremio for large\-scale data processing and data products
* Azure Data Platform Ecosystem including Databricks, AKS, ADLS, ADF, and Azure AI Services
* Vector Databases and Semantic Search technologies
* REST APIs, gRPC, and Event\-Driven Architectures
* Kafka for real\-time data movement
* GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, and Confluence
* Observability platforms such as Dynatrace and Datadog
Security, Governance, and Data Catalog technologies  
* 

  

**Who we are looking for:**

* Penultimate year student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Bachelors or Masters programme.
* Passion for solving business problems using data and AI.
* Strong curiosity and willingness to explore emerging technologies.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with a bias toward learning and experimentation.
* Interest in understanding both technology and business domains.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or C\#.
* Understanding of APIs and modern software development principles.
* Basic SQL and data modelling knowledge.
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices.
* Interest in AI, machine learning, large language models, or intelligent systems.
* Previous experience with the below considered an asset:
	+ Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, or MCP.
	+ Knowledge of data engineering concepts and distributed data processing.
	+ Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.o Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, Dremio, or similar analytics platforms.
	+ Understanding of vector databases and semantic search concepts.
	+ Experience building APIs using Spring Boot, FastAPI, or similar frameworks.
	+ Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
	+ Passion for creating intuitive user experiences and self\-service platforms.
	+ Interest in Data Mesh, data products, data governance, and AI\-enabled analytics.
* **Please note, in order to be considered for the position you must be available for 6\-month internship placement, January – July 2027**

  

**How to Apply:**

**All applicants are required to submit their CV and a Cover Letter. Only complete applications will be accepted.**

**Please note that your application will not be considered complete without submitting your CV and Cover Letter. If during the application process your Cover Letter or CV was not uploaded, please send an email to** **dublinrecruitment@tdescurities.com** **titled “2027 Technology Intern \- Your First \& Last Name”.**

  

**Corporate Profile \- TD Bank Group:**

Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with more than 85,000 employees in offices around the world, The Toronto\-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries are collectively known as TD Bank Group (TD). TD offers a full range of financial products and services more than 25 million customers worldwide through three key business lines:


* Canadian Retail including TD Canada Trust, Business Banking, TD Auto Finance (Canada), TD Wealth (Canada), TD Direct Investing and TD Insurance
* U.S. Retail including TD Bank, America’s Most Convenient Bank, TD Auto Finance (U.S.), TD Wealth (U.S.) and TD’s investment in TD Ameritrade
Wholesale Banking including TD Securities  
* 

  

TD Securities is a leading global corporate and investment bank, delivering capital markets products, advisory services, trading expertise and market insights to corporate, government and institutional clients worldwide. Operating in 30 cities across the globe, we combine deep industry knowledge, innovation and global connectivity to help clients achieve their ambitions.  



  

Through our offices in London, Dublin and Belfast, we support clients across the UK, Ireland and Europe while leveraging the strength of our global platform and expertise.  



  

We are growth\-oriented, people\-focused, and community\-minded. As a team, we work to deliver value for our clients every day.  



  

**Inclusiveness**

At TD, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.  

  

  



**Who We Are**

TD Securities is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.


**Our Total Rewards Package**  

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investment we make in our colleagues to help them, and their families achieve their well\-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary and several other key plans such as health and well\-being benefits, including medical coverage, paid time off, career development, and reward and recognition programs.


**Additional Information:**  

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
  

  

**Colleague Development**

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.


If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.


We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.


**Training \& Onboarding**  

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.  

  



**Interview Process**  

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

jobs.title: Principal / Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. CE\&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.


The Strategic Workload Acceleration Team (SWAT) is a highly technical team that accomplishes three strategic goals:


1\) Work directly with our most strategic customer projects worldwide to ensure they are successful on the platform


2\) Ensure our engineering teams fully understand the end\-to\-end technical details of their services through the eyes of our customers


3\) Share best practices with the larger Customer Success community worldwide.


The Principal / Senior Software Engineer role in Strategic Workload Acceleration Team (SWAT) will drive architectural and programmatic oversight for strategic initiatives, aligned with Microsoft’s priorities around AI innovation and enhancing platform resiliency. By providing depth of insight for architecture improvement and innovation, this role is critical in planning and driving execution of strategic programs that deliver on CE\&S mission and operational goals.


This is a hands\-on technical role spanning across design, build, and production deployment on customer projects with a focus on issue resolution to remove customer production blockers.


Candidates are expected to comfortably switch from a whiteboard to hands\-on engineering. The position location is in the United Kingdom / Ireland with a need to be in Redmond WA regularly to engage directly with the broader team and Azure engineering teams.


There will be up to 50% travel worldwide as this is a customer facing role expected to work directly with customers on site.

 **Responsibilities*** Drive innovation in AI and strategic technologies aligned with Microsoft’s priorities: Holds subject matter expertise in other tools inside and outside areas of expertise. Leads identification of internal tools and creation of new tools that will be useful for creating the product, determining if methods are still applicable for the current solution. Focuses on Commercial Success and platform/product adoption. Shares best practices and teaches others about new tools and strategies. Remains current by investing time and effort into staying abreast of current developments.
* Strengthen customer trust through enhanced platform resiliency and security: Partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project manager, technical lead) to determine user requirements for one or more complex scenarios. Leverages a variety of feedback channels to incorporate insights into future designs or solution fixes. Leads incorporation of appropriate continuous feedback loops measuring customer value, usage patterns, and other actionable metrics of value. Determines additional critical metrics. Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale and shares knowledge with other engineers.
* Drive strategic partnerships with a focus on customer experience: Partners with CxOs to identify, prioritize, and scope programs/projects to significantly improve customer value for Microsoft and collaboration with engineering and product teams. Leads incorporation of appropriate continuous feedback loops measuring customer value, usage patterns, and other actionable metrics of value. Determines additional critical metrics.

 **Qualifications**  

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical field AND extensive years of technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Master's degree in computer science or related technical field AND advanced years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
* Possesses a breadth of knowledge across cloud computing topics and Azure, as well as specialist hands\-on depth expertise across GenAI and platform services.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in Microsoft Fabric, including secure, compliant end\-to\-end solution delivery (data integration through semantic model and reporting), with strong governance for regulated environments (IAM, encryption, monitoring, data governance), plus automation and optimization of pipelines/jobs for performance, cost, and BCDR, and integration with core Azure/Microsoft services; experience building data agents and ability to implement rigorous testing/observability and responsible AI controls.
  

The ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and / or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.

Som seniorutvikler og arkitekt får du et sterkt teknisk medansvar for "Studio" \- vår egenutviklede systemkonfigurator for automasjonsplattformen e\-SEAMatic v4\. Applikasjonen er selve bindeleddet i plattformen vår, og brukes av ingeniørene til å designe skipsautomasjon (IAS/EPMS). Du vil inngå i et dedikert produktteam, sette deg inn i en eksisterende kodebase, og få et teknisk hovedansvar for utviklingen av applikasjonen.


#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**


* Teknisk utvikling: Videreutvikle og optimalisere Studio i.NET 8 og C\# med utstrakt bruk av MVVM\-arkitektur. Du evner å ta ufullstendige problemstillinger, spesifisere løsninger i tett dialog med produktteamet, og implementere disse med et ryddig forhold til kompleks versjonering og plattformavhengigheter.
* Integrasjoner og automatisering: Utvikle og drifte API\-er mot tredjepartssystemer (f.eks. ERP og CAD\-/tegneverktøy). Sentrale oppgaver inkluderer autogenerering av PLS\-kode (IEC 61131\-3\), og på sikt automatisering av systemdokumentasjon for produktleveranser.
* Testing og støtte: Teste egne og andres løsninger, utbedre feil og optimalisere ytelsen. Du vil også bistå med nødvendig teknisk dokumentasjon og fungere som en støttespiller for ingeniørene som bruker verktøyet.

#### **Kvalifikasjoner**


Vi ser etter deg med en solid teknisk grunnmur som fullstackutvikler, med tung erfaring innen i.NET/C\#, API\-design og arkitekturmønstre som MVVM. Du har erfaring med å sette deg inn i og drifte komplekse, eksisterende kodebaser, og har god kontroll på versjonskontroll (Git/Azure Repos). Erfaring med bruk av AI, både for kodeassistanse og som funksjonalitet i applikasjoner er en fordel. Du trenger ikke detaljkunnskap om PLS\-programmering (dette ivaretas av fageksperter), men du må evne å omsette tekniske krav til funksjonell software.


#### **Personlige egenskaper**


Du trives med å jobbe på tvers av teknologistakken. Siden Studio er et sentralt knutepunkt i vår arkitektur, kreves det gode kommunikasjonsevner for å samhandle på tvers av produktteamet. Du motiveres av å ta et sterkt teknisk ansvar for kodebasen, drive frem optimaliseringer og bygge smarte verktøy som forenkler kollegaers arbeidshverdag.


#### **Vi tilbyr**


* En hverdag der du får jobbe med inovative løsninger, der du vil bidra til utviklingen av løsninger som former fremtiden for maritim industri.
  

Hos oss vil den erfaringen du bidrar inn med til, bli satt stor pris på.
* Vi tror på kontinuerlig lærling, og vil utfordre deg til å lære nytt og utvikle deg videre i din karriere i ett av Hagalandets største utviklingsmiljøer.
* I SEAM verdsetter vi samarbeid og kunnskapsdeling. Du vil arbeide i et team av dyktige fagfolk. Sammen skaper vi en kultur preget av utvikling og tett dialog, alltid med et sterkt produkt\- og kundefokus

jobs.title: AI Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Marimekko is a Finnish lifestyle design company renowned for its original prints and colors. The company’s product portfolio includes high\-quality clothing, bags and accessories as well as home décor items ranging from textiles to tableware. When Marimekko was founded in 1951, its unparalleled printed fabrics gave it a strong and unique identity. In 2025, the company's net sales totaled EUR 190 million and comparable operating profit margin was 17\.1 percent. Globally, there are over 170 Marimekko stores, and online store serves customers in 39 countries. The key markets are Northern Europe, the Asia\-Pacific region and North America. The Group employs about 490 people. The company’s share is quoted on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd. www.marimekko.com


**AI Analytics Engineer**


As an AI Analytics Engineer with an engineering\-first mindset, you will play a pivotal role in making AI\-assisted decisionmaking a company\-wide competitive advantage. You will build the semantic foundations, data models and intelligent workflows that let people across the company ask better questions of our data and get answers they can trust and act on. We believe that data at its best is like an operating system for making better decisions, and AI is one of best tools available to put that operating system in everyone's hands.


Your mission is to scale AI\-assisted analysis throughout the company. You'll turn our data into governed, AI\-ready semantic models and build the conversational and agentic analytics experiences on top of them. These will support decisions in areas such as commercial performance, assortment and collection planning, pricing and promotions, and demand and business forecasting.


We are looking for a builder who combines strong analytics engineering and data modeling skills with hands\-on experience in modern AI tooling. You also have the commercial curiosity to find where better decisions create the most value. You know that an AI answer is only as good as the models, definitions and data behind it. You also know how to take AI\-assisted analytics from impressive demo to something the business relies on every day.


You will take the lead on building our AI\-ready data foundation and on driving adoption across teams, so that insight becomes part of how we work rather than something we wait for. Don't worry, you'll also have a great team and tools around you to help along the way.


This is a full\-time and permanent position at Marimekko’s Technology function at HQ in Helsinki. In this position you will report to our Head of Data \& Insights.


**Responsibilities**


Scaling AI\-Assisted Analysis


* Build and operate AI\-assisted analytics experiences, such as conversational analytics, natural\-language querying, automated insight generation and analysis agents, that make self\-service analysis accessible across functions including the necessary guardrails and quality control which build trust.
* Drive adoption across the company by onboarding teams, identifying high\-value use cases, measuring usage and impact, and continuously improving based what you see moving the needle.

Decision Support \& Advanced Analytics


* Partner with business stakeholders to frame key decisions and deliver the data products and analytical models that support them, such as forecasting, scenario and what\-if analysis or customer segmentation.
* Embed insights directly into decision workflows and planning processes, moving the company from retrospective reporting to proactive, AI\-supported action.

Collaboration \& Strategic Insight


* Translate business questions and decision processes into semantic, data modeling and technical requirements and working solutions.
* Act as a bridge between the data team and business units, explaining what AI\-assisted analysis can and can't do in a way that fosters trust and responsible use.

Support in Building Semantic Models \& an AI\-Ready Data Foundation


* Support the team in designing, building and maintaining AI\-ready semantic models covering business entities, metrics, dimensions, relationships and definitions, so that people and AI agents interpret data consistently and correctly.
* Support designing governed, single\-source\-of\-truth metric definitions together with business owners. Encode business logic, context and documentation in a form that AI and self\-service BI tools can reliably use.

**Qualifications**


* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Information Systems or a related quantitative field.
* Proven experience in analytics engineering, data modeling or advanced analytics, with solutions used by business teams in production. Experience in retail, e\-commerce or marketing is a major plus.
* Strong dimensional and semantic modeling skills, with hands\-on experience with semantic layers and metric definitions (e.g. dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views or Cortex Analyst, or similar).
* Proficient in dbt, Fivetran, SQL, Python and Snowflake. Experience in using Omni is considered a plus.
* Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and agents for data use cases, such as text\-to\-SQL, retrieval over business context, tool use and evaluation.
* Proactive and structured approach to development, with a focus on clean, maintainable, tested and scalable code and data models.
* A pragmatic, value\-driven mindset. You prioritize solutions that improve real decisions over chasing a theoretically optimal solution, and you care as much about adoption as about technical quality.

**Why join us?**
  

In this role, you won't just be "doing AI". You'll be building the foundation that shapes how the whole company understands its business and makes decisions. You will have the autonomy to design how data, semantics and AI come together, and to turn analysis from a bottleneck into a capability everyone can use. You'll be part of a forward\-thinking team that values innovation, speed and the purposeful application of technology to create a competitive edge.


At Marimekko we encourage people to be themselves and value diversity. We believe in fairness and doing things together, using common sense and finding joy in our work. If you connect with these values and have the right background, we might be able to offer you a unique opportunity to work in an exciting, international environment with one of the most iconic lifestyle brands.


If you feel like you are the one we are looking for, please send your application including your CV and cover letter with salary expectation via our career site at Marimekko Careers by 18\.10\.2026\. For more information about the role, please contact Antti Voutilainen, Head of Data \& Insights, by email antti.voutilainen@marimekko.com or by phone \+358 40 132 1311 on Friday 2nd of October at 13:00\-14:00 EET or Friday 9th of October at 13\.00\-14\.00 EET. Please note that applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted already during the application period as the goal is to fill the position as soon as the appropriate candidate is found.


*Marimekko's culture and working environment are founded on equality, inclusion and cherishing diversity. Marimekko welcomes and encourages everyone regardless of their national origin, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, religion or other personal characteristic to apply. Recruitment is always based on business need, and the candidates are evaluated on relevant knowledge, skills and experience as well as motivation.*  

  

*Marimekko is ranked as the 7th Most Attractive Employer in Finland amongst business professionals according to Universum’s ranking. Marimekko is also the 5th most attractive employer in Finland amongst business students.*

jobs.title: Computer Engineer
jobs.description:
WETEC is a leading solution provider specializing in measurement and monitoring systems for a wide range of sectors, including Hydropower Dams, MRT, Railways, Structural Buildings, Wastewater Treatment Plants, Groundwater, Monuments, Highways, Tunnels, Bridges, Landslides, Underground Structures, Airports, Harbours, Renewable Energy Farms, Mines, and Climate Change projects. We also focus on Water, Soil, Crops, Climate, Environmental, Waste, and Physical Survey applications.
  
  

Our aim is to be your total solution partner by sharing our knowledge and expertise to help clients select the most suitable products and solutions for their applications, while providing high\-quality scientific instruments, monitoring systems, and technical support services.
  
  

We are looking for a Computer \& Instrumentation Engineer to help bridge the gap between hardware and software. The successful candidate will assist in developing and supporting scalable applications that communicate with physical IoT devices, while also supporting instrumentation systems, data acquisition equipment, and monitoring solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work across the entire technology stack, from sensors and field instruments to cloud platforms, databases, and user dashboards.
  
  

Key ResponsibilitiesInstrumentation \& IoT Integration
  
  

Install, configure, calibrate, and maintain instrumentation, monitoring systems, sensors, and data loggers.
  
  

Assist in connecting data loggers and sensors to monitoring platforms using industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, and other telemetry technologies.
  
  

Support the deployment, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of monitoring systems at project sites.
  
  

Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and proper operation of field instrumentation and monitoring equipment.
  
  

Full\-Stack Development
  
  

Assist in building, maintaining, and enhancing web applications and user dashboards using React, Vue.js, or similar frontend technologies.
  
  

Support backend development using Python, Node.js, or related technologies.
  
  

Participate in the development of scalable applications for real\-time monitoring, data visualization, and reporting.
  
  

API \& Data Management
  
  

Support the design and development of RESTful APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Express.js.
  
  

Manage, process, and validate monitoring data from various instrumentation and IoT sources.
  
  

Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, retrieve, and analyze monitoring data.
  
  

Assist in developing automated reporting and alerting systems.
  
  

Computer Systems \& Networking
  
  

Configure and maintain computers, servers, network devices, and cloud\-based monitoring systems.
  
  

Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and communication issues.
  
  

Support remote monitoring infrastructure and ensure data integrity and security.
  
  

Collaboration \& Project Support
  
  

Work closely with senior engineers, developers, project managers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, refactor code, and improve system performance.
  
  

Assist in equipment selection, technical documentation, and solution implementation.
  
  

Participate in site visits, inspections, and client support activities.
  
  

Prepare technical reports, calibration records, and project documentation.
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  
  

Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply; relevant working experience is an advantage.
  
  

Basic knowledge of instrumentation systems, sensors, data loggers, and monitoring equipment.
  
  

Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, or similar technologies.
  
  

Experience or interest in web development using React, Vue.js, Python, Node.js, or similar technologies.
  
  

Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
  
  

Familiarity with Git version control.
  
  

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
  
  

Good communication and technical documentation skills.
  
  

Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.
  
  

Preferred Skills
  
  

Experience with IoT platforms and cloud services.
  
  

Knowledge of SCADA, PLC, telemetry, and data acquisition systems.
  
  

Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, C\+\+, C\#, or similar languages.
  
  

Understanding of environmental, geotechnical, structural, or industrial monitoring systems.
  
  

Experience with Linux environments and network configuration.
  
  

AutoCAD and technical drawing interpretation skills.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Information security is an integral part of Visa’s corporate culture. It is essential to maintaining our position as an industry leader in electronic payments, and it is the responsibility of each employee to safeguard information, protect it from unauthorized access, and ensure regulatory compliance. Information security has a significant effect on privacy, consumer confidence, external reputation, and/or the bottom line, and it is a priority on everyone’s agenda.

  

The successful candidate will be part of Visa’s Business\-to\-Business Identity \& Access Management team, which is part of the larger Cybersecurity organization. The B2B IAM team has a global focus and is responsive to an evolving threat landscape, regulatory compliance, IT security requirements, and technology architecture. The B2B IAM team is responsible for secure access to business portals and associated services.

  

The Software Test Engineer will support quality, security, release readiness, and platform stability for B2B IAM applications. This role requires test engineering experience, automation skills, full\-stack application testing exposure, security patch validation support, release validation support, and production\-like environment support experience.


Essential Functions:

* Support test planning, test design, execution, and automation for Java, .NET
* Core, Python, and full\-stack B2B IAM applications.
* Develop and maintain automated tests and scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman, JMeter, Java, Python, or similar tools.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, API, performance, smoke, sanity, and post\-deployment validation testing.
* Support full\-stack application testing and troubleshooting across front\-end, back\-end, database, API, middleware, and infrastructure layers.
* Support QA, staging, pre\-production, and production\-like environments by troubleshooting issues, validating configurations, and helping maintain stability.
* Assist with security patching, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, certificate renewals, middleware updates, and patch validation.
* Assist with release management activities including release readiness, deployment validation, smoke testing, regression testing, release validation support, rollback support, and post\-release validation.
* Help improve platform stability through log analysis, defect investigation, root cause analysis, and collaboration with development, security, and operations teams.
* Conduct API and performance testing using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, OpenAPI/Swagger, JMeter, LoadRunner, or similar tools.
* Work with relational databases and directory services to validate data, write SQL queries, troubleshoot issues, and support IAM workflows.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, QA engineers, security engineers, operations personnel, and system engineers to support secure and stable delivery.
* Ensure testing activities follow Visa Development Management Methodology, Visa Technical Security Requirements, SSDLC practices, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Use CI/CD, source control, code quality, and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, Artifactory, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar tools.
* Contribute to test utilities, scripts, dashboards, and automation solutions using Java, Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
* Support the use of generative AI, agentic tools, and AI\-assisted automation to improve test generation, execution, failure analysis, release validation, and support workflows.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and create and maintain test cases, test plans, automation scripts, execution reports, and technical documentation.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience.

  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience
* 2 or more years of work experience.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
* Experience in software quality engineering, test automation, application testing, release validation, or platform support.
* Experience with Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL, shell scripting, or similar programming languages.
* Experience testing Java, .NET Core, Python applications, RESTful services, microservices, and relational databases.
* Experience with automation, API, and performance testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman, REST Assured, SoapUI, JMeter, LoadRunner, PyTest, JUnit, TestNG, or Cucumber.
* Experience or familiarity with front\-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, Angular, Node.js, Bootstrap, Webpack, or jQuery.
* Familiarity with JBoss Web Server, Apache Tomcat, Red Hat Linux, MS SQL Server, LDAP, Active Directory, and Windows environments.
* Experience or familiarity with security patching, vulnerability remediation, release validation, deployment support, platform stability, monitoring, log analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Basic understanding of SSDLC, cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, application security testing, and tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, FindBugs, Black Duck, Veracode, or Fortify.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, source control, containerization, and Agile tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Jira, Confluence, Zephyr, or similar tools.
* Experience or familiarity with generative AI, prompt engineering, agentic tools, AI\-assisted automation, and emerging coding/testing practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (React, Node.js)
jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**About the role**
------------------

This role is hands\-on, with a significant focus on frontend product development using React, while also contributing to backend (Node.js) services and AWS\-based infrastructure. You will participate in technical planning, drive implementation excellence, and occasionally lead feature development end\-to\-end.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build and enhance web editor and user interfaces using **TypeScript \+ React.js** .
* Develop backend APIs, services and internal tools using **TypeScript (Node.js).**
* Collaborate closely with Tech Lead to execute plans and technical direction for the platform.
* Take ownership of features — design, build, test, deploy and maintain.
* Participate actively in code reviews, system discussions and engineering best practices.
* Ensure product performance, scalability and reliability at scale.
* Contribute to AWS deployment workflows, CI/CD and infrastructure improvements.
* Produce clear documentation for systems, features and operational procedures.
* Occasionally lead and drive feature development independently.
**Requirements**
----------------

* Strong experience with **React \+ TypeScript** , especially for production\-scale dashboards. Solid backend development experience using **Node.js (TypeScript)** .
* **Practical experience building with LLMs or generative AI** in production or serious side projects, including prompt design, API integration, and handling non\-deterministic output (evaluation, guardrails, fallbacks).
* Hands\-on experience with **AWS deployments and cloud\-native architecture** .
* Familiar with CI/CD pipelines, environments, and infrastructure as code
* Understanding of scalable architecture, performance optimisation and secure coding practices.
* Able to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams (PM, QA, DevOps, Data).
* Comfortable working in both new and legacy codebases, and learning fast.
* Exhibits strong ownership, clarity in communication and good engineering hygiene.
  

**Good\-to\-Have / Bonus**

* Familiarity with Website Builders / CMS
* Experience with RAG, embeddings or vector search, or with agentic workflows and tool use (e.g. MCP).
* Knowledge of Terraform or other IaC tooling.
* Experience with large\-scale monitoring, observability, or distributed systems.
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**

  

Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.

  

As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** \- we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.

  

**Digital inclusion** \- at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.

  

**Environmental Sustainability** \- Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious 'A list' for its commitment to the Net\-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by2020 **.**

  

Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the **World's Most Ethical Companies** for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business. Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.

  

Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

jobs.title: Research Fellow (Computer Science/Statistics/Electronics Engineering)
jobs.description:
Young and research\-intensive, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (NTU Singapore) is ranked among the world’s top universities. NTU’s College of Computing and Data Science (CCDS) is a leading college that is known for its excellent curriculum, outstanding and impactful research, and world\-renowned faculty.  



A hot bed of cutting\-edge technology and groundbreaking research, the College aims to groom the next generation of leaders, thinkers, and innovators to thrive in the digital age. Located in the heart of Asia, NTU’s College of Computing and Data Science is an ‘exciting place to learn and grow. We welcome you to join our community of faculty, students and alumni who are shaping the future of AI, Data Science and Computing.  



Dr Yingzhen Li ( https://yingzhenli.net ) and her research group at NTU are looking for a Research Fellow (RF) to carry out in research in probabilistic machine learning, causal discovery and GenAI, by exploring cutting\-edge approaches such as causal representation learning, dynamical systems, sequence generative models and world modelling. Emphasis will be on methods that design and implement new architectures for latent dynamic modelling to enable identification of latent dynamical systems from observation data with both causal identification and statistical estimation guarantees. The role also involves exploration for emerging research directions, synthesizing technical ideas, and engaging with GenAI industry and open\-source communities.  



**Job Responsibilities:**

* Conduct the research in AI/ML domains, especially in probabilistic ML and scalable sequence network architectures
* Produce academic publications such as research papers and patent applications
* Contributing to annual report writing and presenting
* Collaborate with faculty, research staff, and students on joint robotics and AI projects and support the supervision of graduate students.
Engage with industry or academic partners when required to explore collaborative opportunities and contribute to project deliverables.  
* 

**Job Requirements:**

* PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Electronics Engineering or equivalent.
* Independent, highly analytical, proactive and a team player
* Excellent teamwork and verbal, written communication skills
* In\-depth knowledge relevant to the project domain.
* Demonstrated capability to conduct innovative research.
* The ability and willingness to adapt and incorporate novel ideas and approaches in scientific industry.
* Demonstrated ability to formulate hypothesis and design effective experimental plans.
* Ability to design and implement new experimental methods.
* High\-level expertise in the required experiment or modelling methods.
* Ability to initiate collaboration research in multidisciplinary team.
* Oversee and report project progress.
Ability and willingness to work some flexible hours.  
* 

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.  



Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.title: Computer & Instrumentation Engineer
jobs.description:
WETEC is a leading solution provider specializing in measurement and monitoring systems for a wide range of sectors, including Hydropower Dams, MRT, Railways, Structural Buildings, Wastewater Treatment Plants, Groundwater, Monuments, Highways, Tunnels, Bridges, Landslides, Underground Structures, Airports, Harbours, Renewable Energy Farms, Mines, and Climate Change projects. We also focus on Water, Soil, Crops, Climate, Environmental, Waste, and Physical Survey applications.

Our aim is to be your total solution partner by sharing our knowledge and expertise to help clients select the most suitable products and solutions for their applications, while providing high\-quality scientific instruments, monitoring systems, and technical support services.

We are looking for a Computer \& Instrumentation Engineer to help bridge the gap between hardware and software. The successful candidate will assist in developing and supporting scalable applications that communicate with physical IoT devices, while also supporting instrumentation systems, data acquisition equipment, and monitoring solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work across the entire technology stack, from sensors and field instruments to cloud platforms, databases, and user dashboards.

Key ResponsibilitiesInstrumentation \& IoT Integration

* Install, configure, calibrate, and maintain instrumentation, monitoring systems, sensors, and data loggers.
* Assist in connecting data loggers and sensors to monitoring platforms using industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, and other telemetry technologies.
* Support the deployment, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of monitoring systems at project sites.
* Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and proper operation of field instrumentation and monitoring equipment.

Full\-Stack Development

* Assist in building, maintaining, and enhancing web applications and user dashboards using React, Vue.js, or similar frontend technologies.
* Support backend development using Python, Node.js, or related technologies.
* Participate in the development of scalable applications for real\-time monitoring, data visualization, and reporting.

API \& Data Management

* Support the design and development of RESTful APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Express.js.
* Manage, process, and validate monitoring data from various instrumentation and IoT sources.
* Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, retrieve, and analyze monitoring data.
* Assist in developing automated reporting and alerting systems.

Computer Systems \& Networking

* Configure and maintain computers, servers, network devices, and cloud\-based monitoring systems.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and communication issues.
* Support remote monitoring infrastructure and ensure data integrity and security.

Collaboration \& Project Support

* Work closely with senior engineers, developers, project managers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, refactor code, and improve system performance.
* Assist in equipment selection, technical documentation, and solution implementation.
* Participate in site visits, inspections, and client support activities.
* Prepare technical reports, calibration records, and project documentation.

Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
* Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply; relevant working experience is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of instrumentation systems, sensors, data loggers, and monitoring equipment.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, or similar technologies.
* Experience or interest in web development using React, Vue.js, Python, Node.js, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Familiarity with Git version control.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and technical documentation skills.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with IoT platforms and cloud services.
* Knowledge of SCADA, PLC, telemetry, and data acquisition systems.
* Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, C\+\+, C\#, or similar languages.
* Understanding of environmental, geotechnical, structural, or industrial monitoring systems.
* Experience with Linux environments and network configuration.
* AutoCAD and technical drawing interpretation skills.

Pay: $4,800\.00 \- $5,500\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Parental leave

Work Location: In person
