jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Roles \& Responsibilities
  
  

ABOUT KRISTAL.AI
  
  

Kristal.AI is a digital private bank and wealth\-tech company built for modern investing. We serve accredited investors and high\-net\-worth families across more than 50 countries, and we are regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, the Securities and Futures Commission in Hong Kong, SEBI in India, and the FSRA in Abu Dhabi.
  
  

Our AI product team builds the systems our relationship managers and operations teams use every day: portfolio optimisation engines, document parsing pipelines, and AI agents that answer client and internal questions from our own knowledge base. We are a small team shipping to real users inside a regulated business.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
  

We are hiring an AI Engineer to build and ship production AI applications for our wealth management platform. You will work on large language model applications, retrieval systems, and AI agents that are used by our relationship managers, operations teams, and clients.
  
  

This is a hands\-on building role. You will own features end to end, from scoping the problem with the business team through to running the system in production. You will report to the AI Product Lead and work alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  
  

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  

* Build and ship production applications powered by large language models, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems over our internal documents, policies, and client communications.
* Design and build AI agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, including tool calling, multi\-step orchestration, and memory.
* Build evaluation harnesses and test sets for AI features, and use them to measure quality before and after every change. We treat evaluation as a first\-class part of the work, not an afterthought.
* Write backend services and APIs in Python to support AI workloads, and integrate with our internal platforms and third\-party systems.
* Work directly with operations and relationship management teams to scope problems, agree what “good” looks like, and deliver solutions that remove real manual effort.
* Monitor accuracy, latency, and cost in production, and improve them over time.
* Apply our controls for data privacy, auditability, and regulatory compliance to every AI feature you build.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

* A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 1 year of hands\-on experience building software or AI applications. This can include internships, contract work, or substantial project work.
* Strong Python. You can write code that other people can read, test, and run in production.
* Practical experience building applications with large language models. You understand prompting, retrieval, embeddings, and where these systems fail.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* The ability to take an unclear problem, break it down, and come back with a working result. Much of our work starts as a rough business need, not a written spec.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will work directly with non\-technical colleagues.
* A genuine interest in finance, investing, or wealth management. You do not need prior finance experience, but you should want to learn the domain.


GOOD TO HAVE
  
  

* Experience building evaluation or testing frameworks for AI systems (for example RAGAS or similar).
* Experience with vector databases and retrieval pipelines.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with data analysis and visualisation.


WHAT WE OFFER
  
  

* Ownership of AI features that go into production and are used by real teams, not proof\-of\-concept work that is shelved.
* A small team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.
* Direct exposure to the wealth management business and to senior stakeholders.
* Structured mentorship from the AI Product Lead, and a clear growth path in AI engineering or AI product.
* Competitive salary, performance bonus, and standard benefits.


We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants on merit, regardless of age, race, religion, gender, marital status, family responsibility, or disability.
  
  

O2O TECHNOLOGIES PTE. LTD.

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Predikt**
-----------------


‍


Predikt is a dynamic Swiss\-Belgian deeptech company at the forefront of innovation, developing cutting\-edge AI\-driven technology. We are an AI\-driven cost \& margin intelligence platform built for enterprise procurement and finance teams, providing unmatched visibility into external cost drivers and their impact on margins. We empower organizations to navigate market volatility, proactively manage risks, protect profitability and make confident, data\-driven decisions. As an early\-stage startup, we are fueled by a strong sense of mission and enthusiasm, striving to make cost intelligence accessible to every procurement and finance leader across the globe.


‍


At Predikt, we are defined by our core values and high ambitions. We are a company that champions integrity, innovation and excellence, creating an environment where everyone supports each other and works collaboratively towards common goals. Our customer\-centric approach ensures we deliver exceptional value and service, while fostering a culture of mutual respect, open communication, and continuous improvement.


‍


Join us on this exciting journey as we transform the way procurement and finance teams understand and act on cost and create a future where volatility is no longer a threat, but a challenge every organization is equipped to face with confidence.


Predikt turns market volatility into structured, forward\-looking cost and margin intelligence for procurement, finance and commercial teams at global CPG and Food \& Beverage enterprises. Our product is live with enterprise customers, and we're now building our commercial team.


Our buyers are a few hundred large enterprises. Deals are significant, sales cycles are long, and decisions involve procurement, finance and the C\-suite. That means go\-to\-market here is about precision, not volume: knowing exactly which accounts and people matter, finding the warmest way in, reaching them at the right moment, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Go\-to\-Market Engineer, you build the engine that turns our target account list into pipeline: the data, systems and automation behind it. You'll work side by side with the founders, who lead our enterprise sales today, and with the Marketing Manager and Account Executive we're adding to the team.


This role sits at the intersection of marketing, sales and engineering. You won't write product code with our core engineering team, and you're not an SDR chasing call volume. You own the machine that makes our commercial team faster and sharper, and you'll run parts of it yourself while we build it.

**What you'll do**

* Build and maintain our target account data: our priority accounts, their buying committees (procurement, finance, C\-suite) and the signals that tell us when to engage, such as leadership changes, input cost pressure, relevant hiring or tooling renewals.
* Map warm routes into those accounts through our network, investors, partners and existing customers, and make them usable for the team.
* Design and run signal\-based outreach that reaches several people per account with messages that are relevant to what just changed for them, across email, LinkedIn and events.
* Own our CRM and GTM stack: clean data, clear pipeline stages, and workflows the team actually uses.
* Support account\-based campaigns and events together with Marketing: targeting, audiences, follow\-up flows and measuring what works.
* Help us grow inside existing customers by mapping the next business units, categories and use cases where Predikt can add value.
* Build tools and AI workflows that help the team research, qualify and follow up faster, for example account briefs before meetings, a reusable library for RFP answers and first drafts of proposals.
* Bring the data on what actually converts into our positioning, messaging and ideal customer profile, together with the founders, Marketing, Sales and Product.
* Continuously test and improve how we generate and qualify pipeline, and fix what's broken without waiting to be asked.

**What success looks like**


After 90 days:

* Our priority accounts and their buying committees are mapped and live in HubSpot, with warm routes identified.
* A first signal\-based outreach flow is running and booking meetings.


After one year:

* A clean, reliable view of our priority accounts and a CRM the whole team trusts.
* A repeatable engine that consistently books qualified meetings with decision\-makers at our target accounts, with the founders spending far less time on prospecting.
* Clear pipeline reporting: where opportunities come from, how they move, and what we should do more (or less) of.

**Our current stack**

* **HubSpot** as our CRM and single source of truth
* **lemlist** for sequencing and outreach
* **LinkedIn Sales Navigator** for account and people research
* **Notion** for call recording and meeting notes
* **Notion** for documentation, account plans and internal knowledge
* **Claude** and other AI tools for research, drafting and automation


This is where we are today, not a fixed list. If you know a better tool for the job, we're open to it. You'll have a real say in how the stack evolves.

**What you bring**

* Experience in B2B go\-to\-market, growth, RevOps or demand generation, ideally in a start\-up or scale\-up selling software to enterprises.
* A technical, hands\-on streak: you can script, automate, work with APIs and data, and you enjoy building your own tools.
* Hands\-on experience with modern GTM tooling such as HubSpot or Salesforce, Clay or similar enrichment platforms, and sequencing tools, plus a curiosity for how AI can make them smarter.
* An analytical mind: comfortable with data and dashboards, and with turning numbers into decisions.
* Strong commercial instinct and the ability to understand enterprise software well enough to speak about it credibly with senior buyers.
* An entrepreneurial, "get it done" mentality: comfortable starting from a blank page, iterating fast and shipping something that works rather than perfecting it in theory.
* Fluent in English. Dutch, French or German is a plus.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**Pay \& perks**

* A competitive salary and a stock option plan, so you share in the growth you help create.
* Meal vouchers of €8 per working day.
* Eco vouchers worth €250 per year.
* A net allowance of €175 per month for working from home and using your own equipment.


**Getting around**

* Mobility budget or company car via Lizy: you choose what fits your life.
* Bike lease option.
* Our Leuven office is a 2\-minute walk from the train station.


**Health**

* Hospitalisation insurance via Alan.


**Flexibility**

* Hybrid work, split between our Leuven office and home.
* Work from abroad for up to 3 weeks a year.
* Bring your own device: work with the tools you know best.
* A flexible reward plan is planned for 2027, so you can shape part of your package yourself.


**Team \& culture**

* A yearly offsite, sometimes in the Swiss Alps, sometimes closer to home.
* Plenty of moments together throughout the year: drinks, our Christmas dinner and other team activities.
* A culture of radical transparency, where open and honest communication is the norm.
* An early\-stage startup that's growing fast, with room to take on more if you want it.

jobs.title: System Engineer (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
**System Engineer (m/v/x)**

Gabitasoft is een full\-service IT\-integrator uit Kapellen met een sterke focus op de dentale sector. Onze missie is om klanten dagelijks te ontzorgen van hun IT\-werkzaamheden zodat zij zich volop kunnen focussen op hun kernactiviteiten. Met meer dan 20 jaar ervaring zijn wij uitgegroeid tot een gevestigde waarde met een groot aantal tevreden klanten.

**Functieomschrijving**

Door de snelle groei van ons bedrijf zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste System Engineer.

Als System Engineer ben je de technische spil op kantoor. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige technische voorbereiding van IT\-installaties: je configureert en test hardware\- en softwareomgevingen, zodat onze IT Engineers deze vlot en efficiënt bij de klant kunnen implementeren. Daarnaast ben je het aanspreekpunt voor de Service Desk bij complexe technische problemen (third line support).

**Volgende zaken behoren tot jouw takenpakket:**

* Je bereidt IT\-installaties volledig voor op kantoor (servers, netwerken, firewalls, werkstations en softwareconfiguraties).
* Je stelt duidelijke documentatie en installatieprocedures op en maakt waar nodig technische handleidingen, zodat collega’s er ook in de toekomst op kunnen terugvallen.
* Je registreert je activiteiten nauwkeurig en zorgt voor correcte technische documentatie in het ticketsysteem.
* Je fungeert als third line support: je neemt complexe tickets over van de Service Desk, zoekt de oorzaak en zorgt voor een structurele oplossing.
* Je deelt je kennis met de Service Desk, zodat zij steeds meer zelfstandig kunnen oplossen.
* Je denkt mee over de standaardisatie en automatisatie van onze installaties en processen.
* Je rapporteert aan de Project Manager en werkt nauw samen met de IT Engineers binnen het projectteam.
* Je werkt voornamelijk vanuit ons kantoor in Kapellen.

**Profiel**

* Je hebt een sterke interesse in IT en houdt je graag op de hoogte van nieuwe technologieën.
* Je hebt minstens 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als system engineer, IT engineer of in een vergelijkbare technische functie.
* Microsoft Windows en Microsoft 365 zijn voor jou geen onbekende.
* Je hebt ervaring in meerdere van volgende domeinen: serverbeheer (zoals Windows Server, Active Directory, GPO’s), virtualisatie (bv. Hyper\-V), firewalls, camera\- en toegangssystemen, netwerkbeheer (LAN, WLAN, switches, routering, VLAN’s, DHCP, …).
* Kennis van scripting (zoals PowerShell of Python) is een pluspunt, gezien onze toenemende focus op automatisatie.
* Ervaring met algemene clouddiensten zoals Microsoft Azure en Amazon Web Services is een voordeel, net als kennis van Entra ID, Intune en VoIP\-telefonie.
* Certificeringen (bv. Microsoft, netwerk of security) zijn een plus.
* Ervaring in de dentale sector is niet vereist: wij leiden je op in de specifieke software en toestellen.
* Je werkt gestructureerd en nauwkeurig.
* Je denkt analytisch en probleemoplossend en gaat bij complexe problemen op zoek naar de echte oorzaak.
* Je haalt voldoening uit het technisch correct voorbereiden en optimaliseren van IT\-omgevingen.
* Je werkt graag in teamverband en deelt je kennis met collega’s.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands en hebt een goede kennis van het Engels.
* Je hebt rijbewijs B.

**Aanbod**

* Je maakt deel uit van een hartelijk en familiaal team met een open werksfeer én een hart voor mensen.
* Je start in een functie die je mee vorm kan geven, met volop kansen om mee te evolueren met de organisatie.
* Ons nieuw bedrijfspand is eigentijds ingericht en rustig gelegen toch makkelijk bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer (trein/bus) en vlakbij de fietsostrade. Er is voldoende parkeergelegenheid.
* Bovenop je loon ontvang je maaltijdcheques van € 10 per gepresteerde dag, ecocheques t.w.v. € 250 per jaar, een bonus, een winstpremie, een hospitalisatieverzekering, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een groepsverzekering, een gsm met abonnement na 6 maanden in dienst, de mogelijkheid tot fietsleasing én 12 ADV\-dagen
* (\= 12 extra vrije dagen ter compensatie van een 40\-urenwerkweek).
* Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om jezelf persoonlijk en professioneel te blijven ontwikkelen, onder meer via interne opleidingen.
* Je geniet doorheen het jaar van leuke teamactiviteiten en gezellige momenten met je collega’s.

**Interesse? Stuur je cv en motivatie naar jobs@gabitasoft.com. Heb je nog vragen over de functie? Bel ons gerust op \+32 (0\)3 500 09 09 en verwijs naar de HR\-Manager.**

With 30 years of history, today **Gaming1** is one of the **international leaders in both land\-based and online games of chance** (casino games, sports betting and poker). Its evolution at the heart of innovation is accompanied by a diversification and specialization of positions, with the creation of new cutting\-edge jobs.


\#LI\-DNI
As part of its sustained growth, Gaming1 is looking for a **Backend Engineer** to join its **Sports Betting Area.**

  

  

A **Backend Engineer** at Gaming1 maximizes customer and business value through high\-quality, user\-centric product experiences.

  

  

Engineers operate within small, autonomous product engineering teams in a high\-traffic, regulated environment, where decisions directly impact platform stability, customer trust, compliance, and time\-to\-market. jobs.title: Azure DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Jobomschrijving:
**Azure DevOps Engineer**
**CONTEXT**
=====================================


AXA Belgium wil het team **Relationship and Contact Management** versterken met een **Azure DevOps Engineer**.


De digitale wereld is een sterk groeiende markt en AXA wil haar klantgerichte front\-end\- en mobiele applicaties voortdurend verbeteren via robuuste, kostenefficiënte, gestandaardiseerde en geautomatiseerde platformen die een snelle ondersteuning van de business mogelijk maken.


Binnen specifieke domeinen van de onderneming levert het Relationship and Contact Management\-team dagelijks diensten op gedistribueerde infrastructuuroplossingen binnen de ondersteunde technologieën (Azure, .NET, MSSQL, IIS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, enz.), volgens de ITIL\-methodologie en binnen een Agile werkomgeving.


Ervaring met **Microsoft Dynamics 365**, **Dataverse** en het automatiseren van hun levenscyclus via **Azure DevOps** is een belangrijke troef, met name voor het beheer van omgevingen, deployments, integraties, beveiliging en monitoring.


Dankzij een sterk helikopterzicht op complexe situaties past onze toekomstige Azure DevOps Engineer deze oplossingen toe in lijn met de AXA\-strategie, de lokale standaardarchitectuur, de operationele richtlijnen en de SLA's die met de business werden overeengekomen op het vlak van productiviteit, kwaliteit en dienstverlening.

**FUNCTIEBESCHRIJVING**
-----------------------


Als **Senior DevOps Engineer** draag je bij aan de volgende activiteiten:

* Je werkt voornamelijk als **Ops Engineer**, met verantwoordelijkheden inzake automatiseringsscripting en development.
* Je werkt nauw samen met diverse stakeholders (developers, testers, cross\-department SPOC's, offshore teams, enz.).
* Je bent verantwoordelijk voor Application Lifecycle Management, problem management en release management, conform de beveiligingsrichtlijnen van AXA.
* Je neemt ook een **FinOps**\-rol op en bent in staat de kosten van een implementatie te evalueren vóór deze wordt uitgerold.
* Je ondersteunt je team en onderhoudt rechtstreeks contact met verschillende stakeholders.
* Je beheert incidenten, begrijpt de end\-to\-end processen en analyseert stack traces.
* Je staat in voor de dagelijkse **Business\-as\-Usual** activiteiten binnen jouw expertisegebied.
* Je implementeert **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** end\-to\-end.

**JOUW PROFIEL**
----------------

* Je beschikt over een bacheloropleiding in IT of een gelijkwaardige richting.
* Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie en technische omgeving.
* Je bent oplossingsgericht en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden waarmee je snel de juiste oplossingsrichting kunt bepalen.
* Je leert snel, toont leiderschap en kunt zelfstandig werken met een innovatieve en creatieve mindset.
* Je beschikt over een goede kennis van het Engels.

**TECHNISCHE VAARDIGHEDEN**
---------------------------

* .NET\-serverbeheer (IIS / Windows Server)
* Azure\-beheer (IAM / .NET\-gebaseerde applicaties / networking)
* Azure DevOps (Git, CI/CD\-pipelines, IaC/YAML, rechtenbeheer)
* Azure API Management (APIM)
* Azure Data Factory
* Azure ARM Templates
* Azure Cost Management
* PowerShell en de verschillende Azure\-libraries
* Serverbesturingssystemen (Linux en Windows)
* Webserviceconcepten (SOAP, REST, API Management)
* Webservers (IIS, HAProxy, Reverse Proxy)
* Dataintegraties (MSSQL)
* Beveiligingsconcepten (SSL, certificaten, security gateways, hardening van resources)
* Monitoringtools (Dynatrace, Application Insights)
* Netwerkconcepten (LAN, TCP/IP, load balancing, firewallbeheer)
* Troubleshooting\- en debuggingtools (OpenSSL, Postman, netwerktrace\-analyse, Kudu, Dev Tools, enz.)
* Kennis van het SDLC\-proces en de SDA\-tools die binnen AXA worden gebruikt vormt een belangrijke meerwaarde (Octopus).

### **Gewenste Azure\-certificeringen**

* AZ\-900 \- Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* AZ\-204 \- Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure

**FUNCTIONELE EN OPERATIONELE VAARDIGHEDEN**
--------------------------------------------

* Kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse en hun architectuur.
* Beheer van omgevingen en deployments tussen Development\-, Test\- en Productieomgevingen.
* Automatisering van de solution lifecycle via Azure DevOps en CI/CD\-processen.
* Integraties met Azure, API Management, SQL en andere systemen.
* Beheer van toegangsrechten, service accounts, certificaten en secrets.
* Monitoring, incidentanalyse en dependency analysis.
* Samenwerking met functionele CRM\-teams en Dynamics 365 Developers.
 *AXA wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de diverse samenleving waarin wij leven en voert daarom al jaren een beleid van actieve diversiteit, non\-discriminatie en gelijke kansen. In dit kader garanderen wij een gelijke behandeling en toegang tot selecties, ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, culturele achtergrond, handicap, geslacht of seksuele geaardheid of andere kenmerken*. *Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af.* **AXA Belgium**  

Meer dan 3000 mensen werken bij ons, vanuit onze vooruitstrevende kantoren in Brussel, Antwerpen, Eupen en Luik. We werken samen met 3200 makelaars. We hebben 3 miljoen klanten en zijn nummer 1 in autoverzekeringen. Het is onze ambitie om onze relatie met al onze klanten te transformeren van betaler naar partner om ons echt te onderscheiden. **Onze fundamenten**
Onze belangrijkste leidraad zijn onze waarden: **Customer first, Integrity, Courage** **en** **One AXA**. Alles wat we doen, daar staan we als één team achter.  

Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af. Meer info in ons Diversiteits\- en Inclusiebeleid. **Wat we aanbieden** **Een mooie beloning voor je werk**
Een competitief loon, eventueel aangevuld met discretionaire persoonlijke en collectieve premies en natuurlijk ook maaltijd\- en ecocheques, een volledige terugbetaling van het openbaar vervoer en een cafetariaplan. **Alle voordelen van werken bij een verzekeraar**
Van groepsverzekering tot ambulante en hospitalisatieverzekering (ook gezinsleden kunnen daarbij aansluiten aan een voordelig tarief) en met tot 30% korting op onze andere verzekeringsproducten. **Een job die zich aanpast aan je leven en dromen**
Een flexibel rooster van 35 uur per week, 36 dagen verlof per jaar om op te laden, evenals de mogelijkheid om gedeeltelijk van thuis uit te werken.
Wij bieden sportlessen op het werk, welzijnsprogramma's voor werknemers en trainingen, om u in topvorm te houden, zowel fysiek als mentaal.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Aftermarket Applications)
jobs.description:
Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.  



You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.  



As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.  



You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.  



You build the back\-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as\-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.  



Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.  



The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C\# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.


**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

You have built back\-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business\-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade\-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.  



You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must\-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.  



**Must\-have**

* **C\# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10\):** recent, hands\-on experience building production\-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
* **Azure:** practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
* **REST API design and implementation:** designing and consuming well\-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
* **SQL databases:** data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
* **Testing as part of development:** unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
* **Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.**

**Strong plus**

* **Apache Kafka:** consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
* **Graph databases:** Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
* **Secure\-by\-default cloud development:** managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
* **Observability:** structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
* **Domain\-driven design:** bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
* **Microservice architecture:** service boundaries, inter\-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
* **Event\-driven and message\-based architecture:** queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at\-least\-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
* **CI/CD with Azure DevOps:** YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).
**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well\-being, and we provide a flexible work\-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.  



You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.


**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).


Apply now

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

SMARTLINK is Atlas Copco's connectivity and monitoring platform for compressed air installations: more than 300,000 connected assets, over 100,000 users worldwide, billions of data points a day. For a large share of those users the mobile app is the connected ecosystem \- commissioning equipment, troubleshooting a gateway that will not come online, acting on an alert \- so it decides how our mobile experience is perceived, often before anyone opens the portal.  



  

A growing part of the roadmap is device onboarding, and that makes this more than a business app: users in the field discover sensors and gateways, connect them over Bluetooth Low Energy, configure WiFi, provision equipment and troubleshoot when communication fails. Your work sits where mobile software, cloud services and physical hardware meet \- flows that have to hold up when connectivity is poor, the hardware is not in a known state, and the person holding the phone is a technician on a noisy plant floor rather than a power user at a desk.  



You join a product team (Product Owner, UX/UI designer, Flutter and .NET developers, test engineers) that owns the whole mobile experience from discovery to production.


You work across the whole product lifecycle rather than implementing requirements handed to you. You help understand the problem, validate the solution, build production software, and then look at whether it actually changed anything for the user.  



  

You move between product discussions, Flutter development, backend services, APIs design and implementation, analytics and troubleshooting. One day is user journeys with the Product Owner and designer; the next is a Flutter feature, an ASP.NET Core endpoint, or working out from Mixpanel why a commissioning flow is being abandoned at step three.  



  

You will be comfortable in a codebase with history and constraints, and you care as much about the problem as the solution \- what frustrates the user in the field is as interesting to you as the architecture behind it.  



**In this role, you will:**

* Build new capabilities for SMARTLINK Mobile in Flutter and Dart, and extend ASP.NET Core services and APIs behind them \- owning a capability end to end rather than one side of it.
* Take part in discovery and refinement: understand the persona and the journey, apply jobs\-to\-be\-done thinking, and challenge a requirement before it is built rather than after.
* Work with the Product Owner and designer from the first sketch, and say so when a flow does not hold once real devices and real field conditions are involved.
* Build the commissioning and onboarding experiences for sensors, gateways and connected equipment.
* Engineer for the field: intermittent connectivity, offline behaviour, slow networks, and failure states that tell the user what to do next instead of what went wrong.

We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.  



You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. The total platform team is 14 people.  



Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in **C\# on .NET** by the same standards as the product code: **xUnit, Testcontainers** to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, **.NET Aspire** to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in **Azure DevOps** pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into **Xray** .  



Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.  



In this role, you will:  



  

* Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
* Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time\-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
* Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
* Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
* Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
* Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
* Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual\-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
* Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
* Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.
**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude \& train for skill". We train you for these positions through on\-the\-job\-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on\-the\-job\-training may be available for you for this position.  



* Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk\-based testing.
* You test services and APIs directly, not through a user interface. REST and messaging, schemas and contracts are your natural working level.
* You write test code, and you write it properly: readable, reviewed, running in a CI/CD pipeline. We work in C\# on .NET with xUnit; another statically typed language is fine, and we give you the room to switch.
* Hands\-on with SQL and comfortable judging whether data and aggregations are actually correct.
* A working understanding of distributed, service\-based architectures: asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
* Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.
**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well\-being, and we provide a flexible work\-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.  



You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Are you an enthusiastic and curious Technical Engineer looking for a challenging professional experience? If so, joining CERN's ORIGIN programme may be the perfect opportunity for you.


As a Technical Engineer in the surface coating and chemistry team, you will contribute to the production of thin films for CERN's accelerator complex. All necessary training on the specific coating set ups and instrumentation will be given.

**Your responsibilities**

* Operate Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) coating setups (sputtering): including assembly, vacuum pumping, bakeout, deposition processing, and disassembly.
* Measure the thickness and composition of thin films using an X\-Ray Fluorescence spectrometer.
* Perform validation and quality control of the performance of Non\-Evaporable Getter coatings (NEG).
* Prepare technical documentation, including reports and procedures.
* Contribute to the design, procurement, and assembly of tooling for the coating setups.

**Your profile**

* Experience in the areas of vacuum technology and the use of vacuum instrumentation, including vacuum pumps.
* Experience in materials for vacuum.
* Basic knowledge in materials properties and characterisation.
* Practical experience in thin films coating is an advantage.
* Familiarity with surface treatments and their execution/preparation is an advantage.
* Experience in Ultra\-high vacuum is an advantage.


Skills

* Ability to work in groups and actively participate in team activities.
* Ability to work independently and communicate progress, priorities and challenges in your work.
* Knowledge and use of Excel and Word, Labview is a plus.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Vacuum and Material Sciences (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Target start date: 01\-January\-2027

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team!**


We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M\-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event\-driven microservices and help shape what AI\-native engineering looks like at M\-KOPA.

**The Impact**

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e\-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering**: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under\-banked populations


**Global recognition**: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges**: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets


**AI\-native from day one**: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on


**Fully distributed**: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C\# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event\-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes\-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end\-to\-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

**Technical Environment**

* **Modern C\# stack**: Distributed C\# and .NET microservices
* **Cloud \& orchestration**: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes
* **Architecture**: Event\-driven, supporting products used at significant scale
* **Observability**: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics
* **AI tooling**: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

**Our Engineering Approach**

* **AI\-native engineering**: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works
* **Guardrails as we accelerate**: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship
* **Own it beyond the pull request**: Design for idempotency, retries, out\-of\-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production
* **The Campfire Rule**: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them
* **On\-call as feedback, not heroics**: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

**What You Need**


We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

**Required Experience:**

* Strong grasp of C\# and .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems \- We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes
* Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour
* Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)
* DevOps culture mindset, including on\-call/production ownership
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones
* Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

**Location \& Benefits**

* Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours
* Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Personalised training budget to support your development
* Home office setup budget
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission**

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

Our technology has created measurable change:

* **Connected** : 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users connected
* **Prosperous** : 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green** : 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e\-mobility

**Ready to build C\#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real\-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud-Native, AI-Driven Platform)
jobs.description:
**Descripción de la empresa**  

Septeo es un actor europeo líder en el sector del software con presencia internacional, reconocido como uno de los cinco principales proveedores de software vertical en Francia. En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.


En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».


Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.


Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.


Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

 **Descripción del empleo** **How You’ll Have Impact**

* Build the Platform Behind the Platform: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi\-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
* Enable Engineering Velocity: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
* Drive Reliability \& Observability: Ensure high availability, performance, and real\-time visibility across distributed systems.
* Architect for Scale: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
* Champion Infrastructure as Code: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
* Embed Security by Design: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure.
* Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or equivalent).
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
* Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (ELK stack, Grafana dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
* Operate, monitor, and tune Microsoft SQL Server databases (performance, backups, high availability).
* Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers (Java / Kotlin, C\#, Node.js) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
* Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tooling (Claude, Codex, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.


You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

**Cloud Building Blocks: AWS \& Azure**


We run workloads on both AWS and Azure. We are looking for solid hands\-on experience with IaaS and core managed cloud services on at least one of them — knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

* Virtual machines \& autoscaling — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets \| AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
* Virtual networking — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints \| AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
* L7 load balancing \+ WAF — Azure: Application Gateway \+ WAF \| AWS: Application Load Balancer \+ AWS WAF
* Web app / API hosting — Azure: App Service \| AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
* Managed Kubernetes — Azure: AKS \| AWS: EKS
* Message queues — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues \| AWS: Amazon SQS
* Object storage — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs \| AWS: Amazon S3
* In\-memory cache — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis \| AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
* Managed SQL Server — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance \| AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
* Workload identity (secretless auth) — Azure: Managed Identity \+ DefaultAzureCredential \| AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) \+ SDK default credential chain
* Secrets \& keys — Azure: Key Vault \| AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
* Transactional email — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) \| AWS: Amazon SES
* Per\-environment configuration — Azure: App Settings \| AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
* Logs, metrics \& alerts — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor \| AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
* Runtime diagnostics — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics \| AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

 **Requisitos*** 5\+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS or Azure — experience with both is a strong plus.
* Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with production experience in Kubernetes (required).
* Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
* Experience with Redis in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
* Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
* Experience working in high\-availability SaaS environments.
* Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including Grafana dashboards and alerting.
* Automation\-first mindset.
* Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
* Languages: fluent Spanish and professional English (both required).


We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands\-on experience with at least one technology in each area: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers \& orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases \& caching.

 **Nice\-to\-Have Superpowers**

* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
* Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
* Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
* Experience in multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with both AWS and Azure.
* Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* French — a huge plus (we can dream!).

 **Información adicional**  

* Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
* Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
* Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
* Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.

Buscamos profesionales con experiencia sólida en desarrollo .NET, arquitectura de servicios y entornos de integración, con capacidad para asumir responsabilidad técnica y trabajar en colaboración con diferentes equipos tecnológicos.

* Responsabilizarse de la entrega del software, asegurando los estándares de calidad y el alcance definido.
* Participar y asumir responsabilidad sobre el diseño técnico de las soluciones.
* Diseñar y documentar los diferentes componentes de la arquitectura.
* Colaborar estrechamente con equipos tecnológicos internos y partners.
* Participar en el desarrollo de arquitecturas basadas en APIs, servicios y microservicios.
* Aplicar buenas prácticas de desarrollo, testing y ciclo de vida del software.
* Trabajar en entornos Agile.
  

  

### **Requisitos técnicos**


* **\+5 años de experiencia en desarrollo .NET / .NET Core.**
* Conocimientos sólidos de programación orientada a objetos y principios **SOLID**.
* Experiencia con **ASP.NET Core, .NET Core Web API y REST APIs**.
* Experiencia con **multithreading y programación asíncrona**.
* Conocimientos de bases de datos **SQL y NoSQL**.
* Experiencia práctica con **Docker y tecnologías de containerización**.
* Experiencia diseñando y desarrollando arquitecturas de **microservicios y servicios orientados a APIs**.
* Experiencia en **testing automatizado**: NUnit, Moq, Cucumber u otras herramientas similares.
* Experiencia con sistemas de mensajería/middleware: **RabbitMQ, TIBCO, SignalR**, etc.
* Experiencia con herramientas de **CI/CD**, Git, TeamCity u otras similares.
* Conocimientos del ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software y metodologías **Agile**.
* **Inglés B2 alto / fluido: imprescindible.**
  

  

### **Se valorará**


* Conocimientos del sector financiero, especialmente **productos Fixed Income**.
* Experiencia configurando herramientas de **CI/CD**.
* Conocimientos de frameworks JavaScript SPA.
* Experiencia trabajando con **AWS**.
  

  

### **Perfil**


Buscamos profesionales:


* Proactivos, motivados y orientados a resultados.
* Con capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas.
* Pragmáticos y autónomos.
* Adaptables a diferentes responsabilidades técnicas.
* Con buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.
* Capaces de gestionar eficazmente sus tiempos y prioridades.
  

  

### **Condiciones**


* **Vacantes:** 4

jobs.title: Software Engineer (C#.NET)
jobs.description:

Oferta oficinas: **Vitoria** (Parque Tecnológico) y **Bilbao** (Torre Iberdrola).

#### **¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?**


Estamos buscando personas a las que les apasionen los retos y que quieran formar parte de un proyecto de futuro. Personas comprometidas, innovadoras, proactivas y con vocación de servicio y trabajo en equipo.  

  

**Descripción**  

  

El objetivo principal del puesto consiste en el análisis, desarrollo y mantenimiento de nuestros productos de soluciones software (ERP/MES) para su evolución y correcta ejecución.  

  

**Funciones**

  

* Desarrollo de la solución más apropiada considerando la arquitectura del sistema y las reglas de diseño.
* Realizar una programación de máximo nivel para la funcionalidad definida.
* Integrar dicha funcionalidad en el sistema y verificar que su comportamiento es acorde a lo especificado, comprobando que se alcanzan los estándares de calidad de Lantek.
* Recoger, analizar y resolver incidencias encontradas durante el uso del sistema.
* Generación de la documentación de los proyectos en los que se participa.

#### **¿QUÉ NECESITAMOS DE TI?**


Para cubrir esta posición pensamos en un perfil con:

  

* Formación técnica en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones y/o disciplinas afines.
* Experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones en C\# .NET y/o JAVA.
* Se valorarán otras tecnologías, aunque NO IMPRESCINDIBLE (Framework .NET, Microsoft SQL Server/ Oracle, Desarrollo de ERPs y/o CRMs, Comunicaciones, Servicios Web...).
* Nivel alto de inglés.
* Capacidad para ser perseverante, trabajar en equipo y tener amplia curiosidad por el aprendizaje y la formación continua.

#### **¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?**

* Contrato indefinido.
* Formato de trabajo híbrido.
* Flexibilidad horaria.
* Trabajar en una empresa referente en su sector que apuesta por la innovación de manera constante.
* Formar parte de un equipo de trabajo dinámico y altamente cualificado.

  

*Si quieres incorporarte a una corporación dinámica y en un periodo de fuerte expansión, dentro de un sector con gran potencial de desarrollo a nivel global, ¡aquí tienes tu mejor oportunidad! ¡Te esperamos!*

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (UAE National)
jobs.description:
**Would you like to help improve reliability and operational performance across complex technologies?**

**Do you enjoy solving technical challenges and driving continuous improvement?**

**Join our Reliability Engineering Team**
-----------------------------------------


As a Reliability Engineer, you will focus on preventing failures throughout the lifecycle of products and services by driving reliability initiatives, leading investigations, identifying performance trends, and supporting continuous improvement programs across the organization.

**Partner with the best**
-------------------------


As a Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for:

* Ensuring compliance with the Manage the Job Cycle (MtJC) process.
* Leading and participating in incident investigations, considering job planning, preparation, and execution when determining root causes and corrective actions.
* Supporting lifecycle management activities through active monitoring and corrective action planning to prevent failures.
* Participating in Risk Assessments (RA), Deviation Waivers (DWR), Management of Change (MOC), and Deployment Readiness Assessments (DRA).
* Participating in engineering design review processes.
* Executing the key steps within the Field Incident Management Process (FIMP).
* Managing FRACAS activities through the DMAIC methodology.
* Applying Root Cause Analysis (RCA) methodologies and developing cause maps.
* Facilitating and leading incident investigations, review boards, and corrective action boards.
* Developing RCA reports, technical bulletins, and field communications.
* Identifying FRACAS trends and prioritizing failure modes for investigation and corrective action.
* Analysing performance data and monitoring operational performance.
* Identifying, reporting, and communicating performance trends.
* Developing and reporting key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Sharing lessons learned across field operations and the reliability engineering community.
* Collaborating globally to support knowledge transfer and best practice sharing.
* Supporting new product development through close collaboration with engineering teams and deployment regions.
* Handling special projects and additional product line specific reliability initiatives as required.

**Fuel your passion**
---------------------


To be successful in this role you will:

* Have a Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM).
* Have strong leadership, planning, interpersonal and influencing skills.
* Have the ability to work effectively within a global matrix organization.
* Have an understanding of service delivery processes and the technical nature of the business.
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Have strong facilitation and presentation skills.
* Be able to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Be fluent in English \& Arabic.
* Have experience presenting detailed technical information to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrate project management capability.
* Have advanced engineering, design and technology development problem\-solving skills.
* Be self\-motivated, structured and capable of working independently within a global interdisciplinary team.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous learning.
* Be Eligible to work in UAE without company sponsorship or legal restriction.

### **Desired Characteristics:**

* Field Engineer or Field Specialist
* Remote Operations Professional
* Product Development Engineer
* Applications Engineer
* AMO Engineer
* Other relevant technical or engineering disciplines

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

 **Working for you**


Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (Angular/.Net)
jobs.description:
Description
BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Full\-Stack Developer (Angular/.Net)!

**Who are we?**

  

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

 **What will you do?**

  

Being part of the team, you will:

* Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications using Angular on the frontend and .NET (C\#) on the backend within an NX monorepo architecture
* Develop and maintain Backend applications and RESTful APIs using .NET/C\#, with Entity Framework Core and SQL databases
* Build responsive, user\-friendly interfaces using Angular with DevExtreme components and modern patterns (RxJS, NgRx, standalone components
* Work with relational databases (SQL Server) and design efficient data models
* Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using Jest and Cypress to maintain high code coverage and quality standards
* Manage version control with Git and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps Services
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving code quality and team practices
* Collaborate with product managers and other developers to deliver solutions on schedule
* Contribute to the optimization of application performance, security best practices, and architectural excellence

 **This position is for you if:**

* You possess minimum 5 years of professional experience in full\-stack development with Angular and .NET
* You possess strong proficiency in C\#, .NET Core/Framework, Entity Framework, and LINQ
* You demonstrate solid experience with Angular (v14\+), TypeScript, RxJS, and modern frontend tooling
* You possess hands\-on experience with NX monorepo structure for managing large\-scale projects
* You are proficient with Jest for writing unit and integration tests
* You have experience with DevExtreme component library for building enterprise UI
* You are proficient with Visual Studio for .NET development
* You possess hands\-on experience with Git version control and Azure DevOps Services (Repos, Pipelines, Boards)
* You possess experience with SQL Server and writing optimized queries
* You have knowledge of REST API design and HTTP standards
* You understand software design patterns and SOLID principles
* You hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* You are a fast learner, team player with strong communication skills and problem\-solving abilities
* You are fluent in French

 **What´s in it for you:**

* Competitive remuneration package including
* a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
* a discretionary performance bonus
* Pension plan
* Lunch vouchers
* Extra days of annual leave
* Flexible working hours and homeworking options
* Parking spots available for a fee within our building
* Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
* On\-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
* Free access to our fitness room
* Sports sessions for small additional charge
* Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
* Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

  

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d’Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park\-and\-ride facilities.

  

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

  

\-

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Integration\-\&\-Validation\-Team und den Entwicklungsbereichen zusammen. Der Einsatz erfolgt hybrid mit einer Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 30 Prozent.


**Wir bieten**
--------------


* Eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im System\- und Softwaretesting anspruchsvoller Kommunikationslösungen
* Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten von der Testumgebung bis zum Feld\- und Abnahmetest
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Fachbereichen und die Möglichkeit, deine Expertise in Netzwerktechnik, Protokollanalyse, Verifikation und Validierung einzubringen


**Deine Aufgaben**
------------------


* Aufbau, Pflege, Weiterentwicklung und Dokumentation komplexer Testumgebungen
* Konzeption und Entwurf von System\- und Abnahmetests auf Basis funktionaler, technischer und operationeller Anforderungen
* Durchführung und Dokumentation von Feld\-, System\- und Abnahmetests
* Strukturierte Aufbereitung der Testergebnisse
* Analyse von Netzwerkprotokollen sowie Troubleshooting in komplexen IP\-Netzwerkstrukturen
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Integration, Validation und Entwicklung


**Dein Profil**
---------------


* Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Mathematik oder eines vergleichbaren MINT\-Fachs beziehungsweise eine technische Berufsausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker
* Einschlägige oder mehrjährige Erfahrung im Softwaretesting sowie tiefgehendes Verständnis von Verifikations\- und Validierungsaktivitäten
* Praxiserfahrung mit komplexen IP\-Netzwerken einschließlich IPv4/IPv6, ICMP, TCP, UDP, DHCP und DNS
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Routing und Switching sowie OSPF und BGP
* Erfahrung mit L2TP, GRE, VPN sowie Sprachkommunikation über SIP und RTP
* Sicherer Umgang mit Jira\-Xray, IBM DOORS, Wireshark und Oracle VM
* Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Ethernet, EtherCAT, VHF, UHF, LTE und SatCom
* Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit C/C\+\+, C\# oder Java sowie ISTQB Certified Tester – Foundation Level
* Strukturierte, analytische und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise, Innovationsfreude sowie sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse

new_jobs.description:
**Job title** : Technical Solutions Architect
  

**Location** : London, UK
  

**Job reference \#** : 33988
  

**Contract type** : Permanent
  

**Language requirements** : Fluent level of English


At **Eni** , we are looking for a **Technical Solutions Architect** within **Eni Trade \& Biofuels** (ETB) in **London** . You will be responsible for providing technical oversight of the local IT infrastructure and technology landscape, coordinating with Group IT teams and external providers, and supporting the delivery and evolution of effective technology solutions.


**About ETB**

ETB is the trading and shipping company of Eni, covering crude oil, refined oil products and biofuels as well as gas, power, LNG and emissions. We are a diverse and dynamic team of around 300 professionals distributed in four offices (London, Rome, Brussels and Singapore) with the addition in Houston of Eni Trading \& Shipping Inc. (ETS Inc) which handles marketing of oils and petroleum products for the US market. Our team is also involved in marketing Eni’s oil equity productions, sourcing hydrocarbons and bio feedstocks, and managing the output of our traditional and green refineries.


ETB is at the cutting edge of sustainability and innovation in the global energy market. As a dynamic force within the Eni group, which is a leader in the energy transition, at ETB we are rapidly establishing ourselves as a key player in the new energy landscape, with a sharp focus on biofuels trading. Our work with bio feedstock and bioproducts is central to our mission of shaping a sustainable future. When you join ETB, you become part of Eni – a leading global energy company with over 32,000 employees in 61 countries. Eni is at the forefront of the energy industry, specializing in exploration, production, transport, and marketing of oil, natural gas and biofuels.


**Main responsibilities**

The D\&IT Business Analyst will play a pivotal role in delivering and transforming the best possible systems for the trading and risk portfolio, partnering with wider D\&IT teams and external parties to contribute to:


* Maintain a broad understanding of the local technology landscape, including infrastructure, network, applications, cloud services, integrations, data flows and key external dependencies.
* Act as a key technical interface with Group IT teams, ensuring local technology needs and initiatives are aligned with Group architecture, cybersecurity standards and strategic direction.
* Contribute to the evolution and modernisation of the local technology landscape, identifying opportunities for simplification, automation, cloud adoption and improved integration.
* Translate business and operational needs into practical technical requirements and contribute to the assessment, design and implementation of appropriate technology solutions.
* Support the evaluation and adoption of new applications, cloud services, AI\-enabled solutions and other emerging technologies, considering technical feasibility, integration, security and operational impact.
* Support technology lifecycle activities, including upgrades, migrations, rationalisation and decommissioning, with a focus on reducing legacy complexity and enabling future capabilities.
* Coordinate technical activities with internal stakeholders and external technology providers, ensuring effective delivery, clear ownership and appropriate technical governance.
* Support incident and problem resolution where cross\-technology analysis is required, helping identify root causes, dependencies and longer\-term improvement opportunities.
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, solution documentation, inventories and technology roadmaps.

**Skills and experience required**

* A university degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or related technical discipline.
* Prior experience in a role related to infrastructure, technical architecture, solution architecture or similar area.
* Experience working in complex IT environments and coordinating activities with central IT teams and external technology providers.
* Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies, applications and system integrations.
  

Experience supporting technology implementations, infrastructure changes, upgrades, migrations and decommissioning activities.
* Familiarity with Microsoft enterprise technologies, including Microsoft 365 and Azure.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to understand technical dependencies across different technology areas.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to combine a broad technical understanding with a pragmatic and hands\-on approach to IT operations and solution delivery.
* Fluent level of English.

**Why ETB?**

* **Impactful Work** : Join a team that plays a crucial role in Eni’s Net Zero 2050 strategy, benefiting from Eni’s strong trading position and global integration.
* **Collaborative Culture** : Experience a truly multicultural, supportive, and dynamic work environment.
* **Career Growth** : Rapid learning opportunities with potential for movement across teams and international roles.
* **Work\-Life Balance** : Enjoy a balanced lifestyle with a comprehensive benefits package that may include health, well\-being, and flexible working options.

**How to apply**

* Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
* Please upload your CV in English.

**About Eni**

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil \& gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio\-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game\-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.


**Working at Eni**

At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well\-being, welfare and work life\-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.


***Energy for action takers***
